translations.source: Ugbu a, anyị nwere ụmụ oke ọnwa anọ na-arịabu ọrịa shuga mana ha anaghị arịazi ya.
translations.reference: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
translations.hypothesis: Now we have four vaccines against malaria and they are all safe.

translations.source: Dr. Ehud Ur, ọkammụta nke ọgwụ na Mahadum Dalhousie nọ na Halifax, Nova Scotia na onye isi oche nke ngalaba ụlọ ọgwụ na sayensi ahụ nke Òtù Ọrịa Shuga ndị Kanada dọrọ aka na ntị na nnyocha ahụ ka nọ n’oge ndị mbụ ya.
translations.reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Ehud Ur, a professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia, and the head of the endocrinology division at Queen Elizabeth II Health Sciences Centre, was skeptical of the study.

translations.source: Ka ndị ọkachamara ndị ọzọ, o kwenyeghị na a ga agwọtanwu ọrịa shuga, o depụtara na ihe nchọpụta ndị a enweghị mmetụta nye ndị nwere ọrịa shuga Taịp 1.
translations.reference: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
translations.hypothesis: Like other experts, he does not believe diabetes can be cured, but says these discoveries could have a therapeutic effect on people with type 1 diabetes.

translations.source: N'ụbọchị Mọnde, Sara Danius, onye odeakwụkwọ Nobel kọmitii maka akwụkwọ agụmagụ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ Swidin, kwuputara n'ihu ọha na ihe omume redio na Sveriges Redio dị na Swidin, mgbe o siere kọmitii ahụ ike inweta Bob Dilan gbasara mmeri na ihe nrite Nobel na mpaghara Akwụkwọ agụmagụ nke afọ 2016 o nwetara, na ha ahapụlarị mbọ ha na-agba inweta ya.
translations.reference: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
translations.hypothesis: On Monday, Sara Danius, the permanent secretary of the Swedish Academy, announced on Swedish radio that the Academy had been unable to reach Bob Dylan regarding his 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature and had exhausted all options in attempting to contact him.

translations.source: Danius si, "Ugbu a anyị anaghị eme ihe ọbụla. Akpọọlam oku ma zijere onye ya na ya kacha arụkọ ozi ịntaneetị ma nwetekwa ụsa nnabata. Ugbua nke ahụ zuru oke."
translations.reference: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
translations.hypothesis: "There's nothing we can do about that," Denuis said. "Call your ISP and ask for a better deal. That's all you can do about that."

translations.source: Na mbu,onye isi Ring, Jamie Siminoff, kwuru na ulo oru ya bidoro mgbe onughi mgbirigba ya n’ulo ahia ya di na ime ebe o na adoba ugboala ya.
translations.reference: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, the Ring founder, Jamie Siminoff, said his company started when he lost his bike in his San Francisco apartment complex.

translations.source: O kwuru na ọ rụrụ mgbịrịgba ụzọ ji WiFi arụ ọrụ.
translations.reference: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
translations.hypothesis: He said he used a portable WiFi router.

translations.source: Siminoff sị na orire ahịa gbaliri elu ka ogosichara n'ihe nkiri Shak Tank n'afọ 2013 ebe ndị ndozi ihe ngosi jụrụ itinye ego na mbido.
translations.reference: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
translations.hypothesis: Siminoff says the business struggled after an appearance on Shark Tank in 2013 when the investors refused to fund the startup.

translations.source: Na ngwụcha 2017, e gosiri Siminoff na chanel igbe onyonyo QVC.
translations.reference: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
translations.hypothesis: At the end of 2017, Siminoff was featured on the QVC shopping channel.

translations.source: Ring dozikwara otu ikpe ha na ụlọ ọrụ ọzọ na-ahụ maka nchekwa, ADT Corporation nwere.
translations.reference: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
translations.hypothesis: Ring is also embroiled in a lawsuit with another security company, ADT Corporation.

translations.source: Ọ bụ eziokwu na otu ọgwụ mgbochi aka na-ele anya egosila na o nwere ike ịbelata oke ndị mmadụ ji anwụ n'ihi ọrịa Ebola, mana ruo ugbu a, enwebeghi ọgwụ ọbụla gosiri hooha na o nwere ike ịgwọ onye bu ọrịa a.
translations.reference: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
translations.hypothesis: While one vaccine has been shown to reduce Ebola deaths, to date, no drug has been shown to cure the disease.

translations.source: Otu antibọdi, ZMapp, gosiburu olileanya, mana ka elebakwuru ya anya, achọpụtara na ọbaghị uru na-igbochi ọnwụ ka esiri chee.
translations.reference: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
translations.hypothesis: One antibody, ZMapp, has shown some promise, but in clinical trials, it was found not to be effective in preventing death.

translations.source: Na nnwale PALM, eji ZMapp mere ihe nruba ama, nke a putara na ndi sayentist jiri ya mee baseline tunyere ogwugwo ato ozo.
translations.reference: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
translations.hypothesis: In the PALM trial, ZMapp was used as the standard of care, against which the other three vaccines were benchmarked.

translations.source: USA Jimnastiks kwadoro ozi Olimpik Kọmitii Amerịka dere ma kwere kwa na oge eruola mgbe onye ọbụla na-eme Olimpiks aghaghị ịrụkọ ọrụ ọnụ ịhụ na ndị egwuregwu anyị niile nọ na nchekwa.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics supports the message of the United States Olympic Committee and affirms that the time is long overdue that every person involved in the Olympic movement work together to ensure the safety of all athletes.

translations.source: Anyi kwere na ihe USOC dere na odimma ndi egwuregwu anyi na klob ha nakwa egwuregwu ga enweta uru n’ihu karia ma o buru na enwe mgbanwe n’ulo oru anyi kama inapu ndi mmadu asambodo ha.
translations.reference: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.hypothesis: We believe that the USOC's written statement that our athletes and our sport will ultimately benefit from this change in the organization's leadership is misguided.

translations.source: Mpaghara jimnasktik nke obodo USA kwadoro nlebara anya nke onwe nke nwere ike igosi ka mmegbu nke ndị lanarịrị ihe mberede Larị Nassar kọwapụtara nwere ike ịbụ ihe metere aka a na-amaghị maka ya na anabatakwa mgbanwe ndị kwesịrị ekwesị.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.hypothesis: The USAG's internal investigation supported the victim's account and found that the abuse by Larry Nassar was known and that corrective action was not taken.

translations.source: Egwuregwu Jimnastik nke mba USA na ndi USOC nwere otu ebumnobi - ime egwuregwu jimnastik, na ndi ozo, enweghi iyi-egwu dika ike kwere nye ogwu egwu isoro nro ha n’uzo n’enweghi iyi-egwu, ziri-ezi na gburu-gburu akwadoro akwado.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics and the USOC share the goal of providing a safe and positive environment for all participants, and those values are best supported by a culture of open communication, transparency and accountability.

translations.source: Na 1960 ga, Brzezinski rụụrụ John F. Kennedy ọrụ dị ka onye ndụmọdụ ya ma mechaa rụọkwa otu ihe ahụ n'oge ọchịchị Lyndon B. Johnson.
translations.reference: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.hypothesis: In the 1960s, Brzezinski served as a foreign policy advisor to John F. Kennedy and later to Lyndon B. Johnson.

translations.source: N’ime nghọpụta nke 1976, ọ dụrụ Carter ndụmọdụ gbasara iwu ndị mba ofesi, wee rụzie ọrụ dịka Onye ndụmọdụ Nchekwa Mba (NSA) site na 1977 ruo 1981, na nnọchi Henry Kissinger.
translations.reference: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.hypothesis: In 1976, he advised Carter on foreign policy, and served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.

translations.source: Dịka NSA, o nyere Carter aka n’ijikwa ihe omume mbaụwa n’ụzọ kwesiri ekwesi, dị ka Nkwekọrịta Kampụ Devidi, 1978; ihazigharị mmekọrịta US–Chaịna n'afọ ndị dị na ngwụcha agbata afọ 1970 na 1980; Mgbanwe ọchịchị Iran, nke butere nsogbu njigide Iran, 1979; mbuso agha nke Sọviet n’ime Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.reference: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.hypothesis: As NSA, he advised Carter on important foreign policy issues, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; the normalization of US–China relations in the late 1970s and early 1980s; the Iranian revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan, 1979.

translations.source: Aghoputara ihe nkiri ahu Ryan Gosling na Emma Stone no n’ime ya maka nturu ugo di iche iche.
translations.reference: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.hypothesis: The film also stars Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone in supporting roles.

translations.source: E deturu aha Gosling na Stone n'otu ndị nwere ịnweta akara nturu ugo Best Aktọ na Best Aktres, n'otu n'otu.
translations.reference: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.hypothesis: Gosling and Stone were both nominated for Best Actor and Best Actress, respectively.

translations.source: Nhọrọ ndị ọzọ gụnyere Foto Kacha, Onye nhazi, Ọrụ nkiri fiim, Nhazi Kọstuum, Ọrụrụ fiim, Exigbo Egwu fiim Mbu, Nhazi mmeputa, Ọrụrụ Ụda, Mwụghari Ụda na Ezigbo Mmemme mbu.
translations.reference: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.hypothesis: Other options include Best Cinematography, Best Director, Best Film Editing, Best Costume Design, Best Film Makeup, Best Production Design, Best Sound Design, Best Original Score and Best Visual Effects.

translations.source: Abụ abụọ sitere n’ihenkiri ahụ, Ọdishọn (Onye Iberibe Ahu Rọrọ Nrọ) na Obodo Kpakpandu gasị, nwetara aha maka abụ mbụ kacha mma. N’ihe nlere nke Lionsgate natara ntinye aka 26 — karia ihe ndi a.
translations.reference: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
translations.hypothesis: Two songs from the soundtrack, "Ode to Sleep" (by The Smashing Pumpkins) and "Tonight, Tonight" (by Smashing Pumpkins), were nominated for the Academy Award for Best Original Song. For the Lionsgate film, there were 26 submissions — more than any other.

translations.source: Ka ụbọchị Sọnde nọ na ngwụcha, Onye isi ọchịchị obodo Yunaịted Steeti bụ Donald Trọmp, kwuru n'ozi e nyere site n'aka onye ode akwụkwọ ndị nta akụkọ, nke sịrị na ndị agha obodo US ga ahapụ Sirịa.
translations.reference: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
translations.hypothesis: On Sunday, the US President Donald Trump said in a tweet that US forces will be leaving Syria.

translations.source: E kwuputara nke a mgbe Trump na Onyeisiala mba Tọkị bụ Rejep Tayyip Erdoghan nwechara mkparịtaụka n'ekwentị.
translations.reference: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
translations.hypothesis: The announcement was made after a phone call between Trump and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan.

translations.source: Mba Turkey ga-anarakwa ichebe ndị agha ISIS enwudere ndị, ozi ahụ kwuru, na mba ndị dị na Europe ajụla ịnabata ha ọzọ.
translations.reference: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
translations.hypothesis: Turkey has also detained some of the foreign fighters, the report said, and European countries have been asked to take them back.

translations.source: Nke a na-egosi na, opekata mpe, ụfọdụ daịnosọọ nwere abụba; ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ nwere echiche a taa, mana ihe ọzọ bụ na ọ na-egosi anyị ihe fosịl enweghị ike igosi, dịka agba na nhazi akụkụ-atọ.
translations.reference: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.hypothesis: This indicates that, at least, some dinosaurs were warm blooded; most people believe this today, but another thing is that it shows us something that fossils cannot show, such as colour and texture.

translations.source: Ndị ọka mmụta sayensị kwuru na abụba anụmanụ a nwere mgbe ọ na-acha aja aja n'elu ma na-acha ka karotenọịd n'okpuru.
translations.reference: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists say the animal's fur is black with a reddish-brown tint.

translations.source: Ihe nchọpụta ahụ nyekwara ntụziaka gbasara mmalite ipu nku n'ụmụ nnụnụ.
translations.reference: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
translations.hypothesis: The study also provided insights into the origins of avian influenza viruses.

translations.source: Maka na nku ajọ anụ daịnosọ enweghị akụ toro nke ọma, nke a na akpọ rachis, ma na o nwere ihe ndị ọzọ nke na-enwe - dịka barbs na barbules - ndị nchọpụta ihe kwuru na ọdịka rachis ọbụ ihe mechara si n'ihe ndị ọzọ a were toputa.
translations.reference: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.hypothesis: Because the fossil had a poorly preserved tail, which is called a rachis, and it had other things coming out of it that the discoverers said looked like the end of the rachis or possibly some other part of the animal, they decided to call it a tail.

translations.source: Nhazi nku ha gosiri na ha ejighi ya efe efe kama ha ji ya edokwa okpomọkụ maọbụ eme ihe ngosi. Ndị nchọpụta ihe tụrụ aro sị na, n'agbanyeghị na nke a bụ ọdụ daịnosọ na-eto eto, ihe ngosi ahụ gosiri nku anụ tochara etocha na-abụghị nku nwa anụ.
translations.reference: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: The arrangement of the bones shows that they were not used for flying but were used for display or possibly for thermoregulation. The discoverers suggest that, although this was a juvenile dinosaur, the display features indicate that the adult form would have had a very large crest and not the small crest of the juvenile.

translations.source: Ndị nchọpụta ihe tụrụ aro sị na, n'agbanyeghị na nke a bụ ọdụ daịnosọ na-eto eto, ihe ngosi ahụ gosiri nku anụ tochara etocha na-abụghị nku nwa anụ.
translations.reference: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: The researchers suggested that, although this was a juvenile dinosaur, the specimen showed a bird-like beak and teeth that were not suitable for an herbivore.

translations.source: Otu bọmbụ gbawara n'isi ụlọ ọrụ ndị uwe ojii n’ime Gaziantep, Tọkii ụtụtụ ụnyaahụ na-egbu ndị uwe ojii abụọ ma merụọ ahụ ihe karịrị ndị mmadụ ọzọ iri abụọ.
translations.reference: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
translations.hypothesis: A bomb exploded near a police station in Gaziantep early this morning killing two officers and injuring more than twenty other people.

translations.source: Ụlọ ọrụ gọvanọ kwuru iri na itoolu na ndị merụrụ ahụ bụ ndị uwe ojii.
translations.reference: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
translations.hypothesis: Eleven of the dead were police officers, the governor's office said.

translations.source: Ndị uwe ojii sị na ha na-enyo otu onye a na-ebo ebubo na ọ bụ onye agha nnupuisi Daesh (ISIL) dịka onye mere mwakpo ahụ.
translations.reference: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
translations.hypothesis: Police said they are treating the man as a suspect and are investigating him as a possible Daesh (ISIL) operative.

translations.source: Ha chọpụtara na Anyanwụ na-arụ ọrụ n’otu ụdị isi iwu dịka kpakpandu ndị ọzọ: A chọpụtara na omume kpakpandu niile nọ na sistemụ bụ onwunwu ọkụ na ntụgharị ha na-anya ha, ma ọ nweghị ihe ọzọ..
translations.reference: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
translations.hypothesis: They found that the Sun worked in a similar way to other stars: they are all balls of gas and their properties depend on their mass and temperature, and nothing else.

translations.source: A na-ejikọta ọnụ ọnwụnwụ ọkụ na ntụgharị ya amata akara Rossby nke otu kpakpando, nke metụtara na ọwụwụ plasma.
translations.reference: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.hypothesis: The magnetic field lines are connected to the sun's magnetic poles, and their rotation drags the plasma around.

translations.source: Ka akara Rossby na-adị obere karịa, ka arụmarụ na-adịkwu obere nke kpakpando n’ikwanye ugwu nye ụmụ ntụgharị nke ihendọta.
translations.reference: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.hypothesis: The smaller the Rossby number, the more the flow is constrained by the bottom topography.

translations.source: Na njem ya, Iwasaki banyere na nsogbu ọtụtụ mgbe.
translations.reference: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
translations.hypothesis: On his journey, Iwasaki faced many difficulties.

translations.source: Ndị ohi ụgbọ mmiri zuri ya ohi, nkịta ara lụsoro ya ọgụ, o siri na-alụm di na nwunye gbalaga na Nepal a tụọ ya nga na India.
translations.reference: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.hypothesis: The sailors blamed the storm, the horses blamed the rider, and the rider complained to his wife, who was staying in a temple in Nepal.

translations.source: Oke 802.11n na arụ ọrụ ma na frikwensi nke 2.4Ghz na nke 5.0Ghz.
translations.reference: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.hypothesis: 802.11n operates on both 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.

translations.source: Nke a ga-enye ya ohere ka dịrị na ndakọta nlaghachi azụ na 802.11a, 802.11b na 802.11g, ma ọ bụrụhaala na isi ebe ahụ ụgbọigwe na-anọ nwere redìò abụọ.
translations.reference: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.hypothesis: This gives it more range than 802.11a, 802.11b or 802.11g, although the central hub needs to have a dual-band radio.

translations.source: Na 802.11n, ọsịsọ ya ji nnukwu ihe kara nke ndị bu ya ụzọ; ya mere, ọrụ ọ na-arụpụta ga-eru 600Mbit/s.
translations.reference: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: 802.11n is faster than its predecessors; its data rates can go up to 600 Mbit/s.

translations.source: Duval, bụ onye lụgoro nwanyị ma mụta ụmụ abụọ bụgoro okenye, a hapụghịrị Mila onyere akọọrọ akụkọ nnukwu ihe nlere anya.
translations.reference: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
translations.hypothesis: Duval, a married man with two grown children, was released after giving Mila a false confession.

translations.source: Mgbe a sị ya kwuo okwu gbasara ihe mere, Mila kwuru, "Mike na-ekwu ọtụtụ okwu mgbe a na-eme ọnụnụ ahụ...anọ m na-akwado ya mere na anụghị m ihe ọ na-ekwu."
translations.reference: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
translations.hypothesis: When asked to comment on what really happened, Mila said, "Mike was saying things during the appointment that I disagreed with and I told him that I was not comfortable with what he was saying."

translations.source: Anyị ga-agba mbọ belata ikuku kabon dioxide kwa nke Mkpokọta ihe nrụpụta obodo site na oke 2020 site n'ọkwa 2005, Hu kwuru.
translations.reference: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
translations.hypothesis: We will make every effort to reduce carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by 2020 compared to 2005 levels," Hu said.

translations.source: O kwughi oke a ga-akwụ, kama ọ sị na a ga-ele anya na nrụpụta akụ na ụba China wee kwụọ ụgwọ.
translations.reference: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
translations.hypothesis: He did not specify a price, but said that the Chinese economic output should be considered in evaluating the cost.

translations.source: Hu gbara obodo ndị na emepe emepe ume "ka ha ghara itinye aka n'usoro omume mgbe ochie bụ ibu ụzọ metọọ were kpochawa ma emechaa."
translations.reference: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
translations.hypothesis: Hu exhorted the local authorities "not to interfere with the old established customs of the people, no matter under what pretexts."

translations.source: O tinyekwara na "ha ekwela ka adị ha buru ibu karịrị ogugo uto na ike ha."
translations.reference: He added that "they should not, however, be asked to take on obligations that go beyond their development stage, responsibility and capabilities."
translations.hypothesis: He added that "they are more resilient than their weight and power would suggest."

translations.source: Òtù Mmụta Irak ahụ gosipụtara nchọpụta ya na 12.00 GMT taa.
translations.reference: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.
translations.hypothesis: The Iraqi team will present its findings at 12.00 GMT today.

translations.source: Ọ dọrọ aka na ntị sị na onweghị onye ga-ekwe nkwa na usoro ọbụla e jiri mee ihe na mba Aịrak ugbu a ga-akwụsị agha otu, ntolite ihe ike, maọbụ ndabanye n'ọgbaghara.
translations.reference: It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos.
translations.hypothesis: It is doubtful that any agreement reached in the current atmosphere of mutual suspicion and hostility will stop the fighting, end the violence, or bring about a just and lasting peace.

translations.source: Di Rịpọt bidoro site n'ịkpọ oku ka onye ọbụla nwee mkpakọrịta ụka ma nwee nkwekọrịta n'Amerịka gbasara etu aga na-esi akpaso ndị Etiti Ọwụwa Anyanwụ agwa.
translations.reference: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.
translations.hypothesis: Ripley's initial idea was to call everyone who had ever voiced an opinion on the subject of UFOs in the United States and get their comments.

translations.source: Ọ fọrọ obere ka mkpesa ahụ kwuo okwu ofụma gbasara akụkụ nile nke iwu ndị isi n'ebe mba Aịrak nọ ma ọ na-akwado mgbanwe ụzọ ozigbo ozigbo.
translations.reference: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
translations.hypothesis: The resolution also expressed concern over the political polarization in the country and encouraged dialogue.

translations.source: Nke izizi n'ime nkwado iri asaa na asatọ ya bụ na a ga-eso usoro ọchịchị ọhụrụ tupu ọgwụgwụ afọ ị hụ na echebere oke ala Aịrak megide ndị ọchọ okwu ma wughachikwa mmekọrịta ọchịchị ha na agbataobi ha.
translations.reference: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
translations.hypothesis: The first of its seven recommendations is that the new government should, before the end of the year, ensure that the territory is fully protected from terrorist attacks and that political relations with its neighbors are normalized.

translations.source: Onye omeiwu nakwa nwunye onyeisiala mba Argentina bụ Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner mara ọkwa na mgbede ụnyahụ na La Plata, obodo nọpụrụ kilomita 50 (maịlụ 31)site na Buenos Aires na ọ ga-eso zọọ ọkwa onyeisiala mba Argentina.
translations.reference: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: The senator and former president of Argentina Cristina Fernández de Kirchner was shot in the arm late Thursday in La Plata, a city 50 miles (31 miles) from Buenos Aires, and is expected to be released from the hospital today.

translations.source: Ọ bụ n'Ajentaịn Tiyeta ka Lọọlọ Kirchner kwuputara ebumnuche ya ịzọ maka ọkwa onye isi ala, otu ebe ahụ ọ ji bido kampen ya maka ọkwa Sịnetọ na 2005 dịka onye otu nke ndị mpaghara Buenos Aires zigara.
translations.reference: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
translations.hypothesis: It was at the Eva Perón Auditorium that Kirchner announced his bid for the presidential nomination, the same venue he used to launch his campaign for the Senate seat in 2005 as a candidate for the Buenos Aires province.

translations.source: Ọ bụ esemokwu maka mmefu ego na nkwado na nrụgharị e mere mgbe Oke ikuku Katrina gasịrị kpatara arụmụka a; ụfọdụ ndị kweere na iji nwayọ emefụ ego steeti akọwaala mmefụ a n'ụzọ ntọrọmọchị dịka "Nkwekọrịta Niu Ọlịns nke Bush mere".
translations.reference: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.hypothesis: The controversy over the amount of money spent and the distribution of aid after Hurricane Katrina led to this fight; some believe the misspending of state funds was due to the fact that the governor had been indicted.

translations.source: Nnyocha nke mgbalị nrụgharị chere ihu na-enye ndị e chere na ha bụ ndị si Wọshịntịn ọrụ nrụgharị.
translations.reference: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
translations.hypothesis: The investigation of the alleged break-in provided Washington police with a lead.

translations.source: Ihe karịrị nde mmadụ anọ gara Rom maka olili ahụ.
translations.reference: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
translations.hypothesis: Over four million people went to Rome for the Jubilee.

translations.source: Ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị mmadụ nọ ebe n'ahụ dị ukwuu nke na o kweghị mmadụ niile omume inwèta òhèrè n'olili ozu na St. Peter Square.
translations.reference: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
translations.hypothesis: The number of people in the square was so great that it was impossible for everyone to see the Pope and the main events taking place on the platform in St. Peter's Square.

translations.source: Etinyere ọtụtụ nnukwu igwe onyonyo n'ọtụtụ ebe na Rom, ka ndị mmadụ nwee ike kirie mmemme ahụ.
translations.reference: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
translations.hypothesis: Many large screens were set up in various parts of Rome, so people could watch the event.

translations.source: N'ọtụtụ obodo Itali ndị ọzọ ma na uwa nile, ọkachasị na Poland, emere nkwazi dị ka ibe ya, nke ọtụtụ mmadụ hụrụ.
translations.reference: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
translations.hypothesis: In many other Italian and foreign cities, especially in Poland, similar events were held, which were attended by several hundred people.

translations.source: Ndị akụkọala akọtọla ụmụ iwuikikere FBI ndị gara aga maka ịgbado anya akụrụngwa n’ụmụ okwu ndị dị mfe ikpezi, tụmadị ụmụ okwu ụgbọ ala ezuru ezuru, n’iji ebumnobi nke ịkwalite nsìàga ọganihu ha.
translations.reference: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
translations.hypothesis: The FBI's backlog of older cases was cleared by prioritizing the most egregious cases, particularly those involving child victims, with the goal of improving their success rate.

translations.source: Nzukọ omeiwu bidoro ikwado nnyocha ihe ndị dị aṅaa na fiskal n'afọ 2005 ma kwukwaa kpọmkwem na ngalaba FBI ga ewepụtarịrị ndị ozi iri maka ihe ngosi na-akpali agụụ mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị.
translations.reference: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
translations.hypothesis: The legislative body began supporting the annual gay pride march in 2005 and officially banned the FBI from removing any protesters.

translations.source: Robin Uthappa nwetara akara kachasị na innings, ọsọ 70 n’ime naanị ụmụ bọọlụ 41 site n’ịkụ anọ ugboro 11 na isii ugboro 2.
translations.reference: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
translations.hypothesis: Robin Uthappa was the highest scorer in the innings with 70 runs off just 41 balls with 11 fours and 2 sixes.

translations.source: Ndị na-eji batị akụ n'usoro etiti, Sachin Tendulkar na Rahul Dravid rụrụ ọrụ nke ọma ma mee otu nrụkọọrụ nke ọsọ-otu narị.
translations.reference: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
translations.hypothesis: The experienced pair of Rahul Dravid and Sachin Tendulkar at the top of the order ensured a steady start and a 100-run partnership.

translations.source: Mana, mgbe ha dara wicket India naanị mere 36 gbara ọ tọpụ wicket 7 iji kwụsị innings.
translations.reference: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
translations.hypothesis: However, after losing the wickets, India were all out for 36 with 7 wickets in hand.

translations.source: U.S. Onye isi oche Jiọj W. Bush batata Singapọ n'ụtụtụ ụbọchị nke iri na isii nke ọnwa Nọvemba, iji malite njem njegharị mba Eshia nke ga-anọzu otu izuụka.
translations.reference: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
translations.hypothesis: U.S. President George W. Bush landed in Singapore on the morning of November 16, beginning a 10-day tour of Asia.

translations.source: Onye na-esote onye isi iche mba Sịngapọ bụ Wong Kan Seng nabatara ya ma ya na onye isi oche mba Sịngapọ bụ Lee Hsien Loong kparịtara ụka gbasara ahịa na ihe iyi ọha egwu.
translations.reference: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.hypothesis: The deputy prime minister, Wong Kan Seng, and the prime minister of Singapore, Lee Hsien Loong, both expressed concern over the economic and social costs.

translations.source: Mgbe otu izu gasịrị ebe ọ dara ada na ntuliaka ọkara oge, Bush gwara ndị na-ege ya ntị maka mmụba nke azụmahịa n'Eshia.
translations.reference: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
translations.hypothesis: A week after the midterms, Bush told business leaders that he would appoint someone to improve trade with Asia.

translations.source: Onye isi oche Stivin Hapa ekwetala iziga iwu ọhụrụ nke ikuku ọcha nke gọọmenti ebe a ga elebara ya anya, tupu nleba anya nke abụọ, ma emechaa nzukọ ga-ewe ya na onye isi NDP bụ Jak Leeton nkeji iri abụọ na ise n'ụbọchị Tuzde na PMO.
translations.reference: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
translations.hypothesis: Premier Steven Harper agreed to a Liberal proposal for a second reading of the new clean air legislation, and a meeting was set for 2:30 p.m. Tuesday in the PMO with NDP Leader Jack Layton.

translations.source: Layton arịọla maka mgbanwe nye akwụkwọ iwu gburugburu ebe obibi nke ndị otu ọdịkaọgadị mgbe ya na PM nwere nnọkọ, na-arịọ maka "ndezigharị zuru oke nke zuru ezu" nke iwu gburugburu ebe obibi nke ndị otu ọdịkaọgadị
translations.reference: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
translations.hypothesis: Layton has reportedly asked for changes to the environmental legislation from the senior partner in the firm, asking for "significant amendments" to the environmental legislation.

translations.source: Kemgbe gọọmenti weere ọnọdụ ịkwụ ụgwọ ụlọ ọgwụ Mersey na Devọnpọt, Tasmania, gọọmenti steeti na ụfọdụ ndị ome iwu gọọmenti etiti ekwuola okwu megide omume a sị na ọ bụ mere mere n'ihu maka ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị gọọmenti etiti na-abịa na Nọvemba.
translations.reference: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
translations.hypothesis: Since the government takeover of the Mersey Devonport hospitals, the state government and some federal politicians have criticised the action as a lead up to the federal election in November.

translations.source: Mana Prime Minista John Howard ekwuola na ihe a mere bụ naanị ka ichebe ụmụ akụrụngwa nke ụlọ ọgwụ ahụ site n'aka mwedàta siri n'aka gọọmentị Tasmania, n'inye mmezi nke nde AUD$45.
translations.reference: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
translations.hypothesis: But Prime Minister John Howard said the action was only to protect the hospital's assets from the Tasmanian Government's alleged mismanagement, offering a $45 million upgrade.

translations.source: Dika obere akwụkwọ akụkọ kachasị ohuru si kwuo, ogugu oke osimiri gosiri na oke ikuku malitere. O doro anya na enwere oru oke ikuku na mpaghara Pago Pago na Niue.
translations.reference: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
translations.hypothesis: According to the latest news reports, the sea level has started to drop. There is a high pressure system over the Cook Islands and Niue.

translations.source: O nweghị nnukwu mmebi ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ akọrọna n’ime Tonga, mana e were ọkụ nwa oge, nke a kọrọ gbochiri ndị ọchịchị Tongan ịnata ịdọ aka na ntị maka ajọ ebili mmiri PTWC ahụ nyere.
translations.reference: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
translations.hypothesis: There were no major injuries or damage reported in Tonga, but a temporary communications blackout prevented Tongan authorities from receiving alerts from the PTWC.

translations.source: Ụlọ akwụkwọ iri na anọ na Hawaii ndị nọ na ma ọ bụ na nso akụkụ mmiri bụ ndị e mechiri na Wenezdee niile na-agbanyeghị ndọ aka na ntị niile ewepụrụ.
translations.reference: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
translations.hypothesis: All 14 schools in Hawaii that were closed on Wednesday due to a false bomb threat have reopened.

translations.source: Onyeisiala mba Amerịka bụ George W. Bush nabatara ọkwa ahụ.
translations.reference: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
translations.hypothesis: The American President George W. Bush accepted the offer.

translations.source: Gọdọn Jọndro onye na-ekwuchitere Bush okwu kpọrọ nkwa Nọt Koria bụ "nzọụkwụ dị oke mkpa na ịnweta mwepụ were anya nke ngwa agha nuklia ndị Koria."
translations.reference: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
translations.hypothesis: Gordan Jandro, Bush's chief of staff, called the North Korean announcement "a significant step toward the elimination of the nuclear threat."

translations.source: Oke ifufe nke iri abụrụ aha nke oge oke ifufe Atlantik, Oke ifufe akpọrọ Jeri, gbakọrọ n'oke osimiri atlantik taa.
translations.reference: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
translations.hypothesis: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic hurricane season, Tropical Storm Jerry, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

translations.source: Ụlọọrụ Etiti na-ahụ maka Ajọ ifufe (NHC) kwuru sị n’oge a Jeri abụghị ihe iyi egwu nye ala.
translations.reference: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
translations.hypothesis: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) said at the time that Jerry was not a threat to land.

translations.source: Ụlọ Ọrụ nke Ndị injinia nke U.S. mere atụmatụ na mmiri mmiri dị inchi isii nwere ike ịgabiga ihe mgbochi ide mmiri e mebibiri na mbụ.
translations.reference: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
translations.hypothesis: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers estimates that a six-inch rise in sea level could submerge the existing levee system.

translations.source: Ward Itoolu, nke hụrụ oke ide mmiri ruru ihe dị ka feet iri abụọ n'oge Ajọ Ifufe Katrina, nọ na nnukwu mmiri na eru ukwu ma gafere akwa levee nọ nso.
translations.reference: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
translations.hypothesis: Ward 11, which saw up to 20 feet of water during Hurricane Katrina, was surrounded by water and the adjacent levee was overtopped.

translations.source: Mmiri n’aghafu n’otu akuku levee obodobo ya di 100feet.
translations.reference: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
translations.hypothesis: Water flowed over the top of the 100-foot-high levee.

translations.source: Onye nchikwa commons Adam Cuerden gosiputara iwe ya  n’elu ihe eghichapuru mgbe ogwara Wikinews okwu n’onwa gara gara.
translations.reference: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
translations.hypothesis: Commons administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over recent events in a blog post last month.

translations.source: O (Wales) n’ezie turu anyi asi site na mbido. Mbu, site na ikpa-agwa ka ihe a bu okwu iwu, Nke abuo, site na igho-aghugho na ona ege anyi nti, ruori mgbe ehichapuru nka ya.
translations.reference: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
translations.hypothesis: (Wales) has actually won this round from the start. First, by framing this as a legal issue, and second, by appealing to our sense of justice, right up to the point of artistic license.

translations.source: Mkpadu iwe obodo butere maka mgbali ide iwu gbasara ihe ngosi mmekọahụ na webụsaịtị na-egosi ọtụtụ ihe.
translations.reference: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
translations.hypothesis: The public outcry led to the censorship of websites containing explicit material.

translations.source: Ọrụ arụrụ bụkarịrị nke iwu a ka na enyocha enyocha, mana edere usoro omume ihe ahụ ka o gosipụta ihe ahụtara ụyọkọ kpakpando Sajiterius.
translations.reference: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.hypothesis: The work is mostly done in the name of this law, but the process is designed to resemble the discovery of the planet Jupiter.

translations.source: Mmetụta otu ahụ nọ na-achọ ga-esite n'aka ikikere taịdị ndị dị n'etiti mata ojii nke galaxy na mata ojii nke Milky Way.
translations.reference: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
translations.hypothesis: The effect being sought is from the gravitational pull of a black hole at the center of the Milky Way galaxy.

translations.source: Dị ka ọnwa na etinye ndọta n’ụwa, na-akpata elili mmiri, etu ahụ ka Milky Way ahụ si etinye ike na galazi Sagittarius ahụ.
translations.reference: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.hypothesis: Just as the moon exerts a tidal force on the Earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a tidal force on Sagittarius Dwarf Galaxy.

translations.source: Ndị ọka mmụta sayensị nwere ike kwubie na dak mata na emetụta dak mata ibe ya otu mata si eme.
translations.reference: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists can tell you exactly how many rings a tree has and how far apart the rings are.

translations.source: Tiori a na-ekwu na imirikiti mata dị oji gburugburu otu ụyọkọ kpakpando dị na gburugburu otu ụyọkọ kpakpando n'otu ụdị halo, ma e mejupụtara ya site n'ọtụtụ urughuru dị obere.
translations.reference: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
translations.hypothesis: This theory says that most stars are black holes in disguise, and they are all part of a larger whole, and they are made up of many smaller black holes.

translations.source: Ụmụ akụkọ si telivishọn na-egosi anwụrụ ọcha si n'igwe nrụpụta ahụ apụta.
translations.reference: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
translations.hypothesis: TV news reports showed black smoke billowing from the factory.

translations.source: Ndị isi obodo na-adọ ndị bi n'obodo gburugburu igwe ọrụ ahụ aka na ntị ka ha nọrọ n'ime ụlọ, gbanyụọ ntụ oyi ma ghara iṅu mmiri na-agba n'ụlọ.
translations.reference: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
translations.hypothesis: Authorities urge civilians in the area to take shelter indoors, turn off the gas and electricity, and avoid using elevators.

translations.source: Na ndabere nke ụlọ ọrụ nuklia Japan, a chọpụtawo n'ụlọ mmepụta cesium na ayodiin dị redioaktivu.
translations.reference: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
translations.hypothesis: According to the Japanese nuclear industry, radioactive iodine and cesium were detected in the reactor buildings.

translations.source: Ndị isi chere na nke a na-egosi na o nwere ike gbọmgbọm ndị ji mmanụ ụgbọ yurenium agbawaala ma na-ehi ehi.
translations.reference: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
translations.hypothesis: Authorities believe this is due to the fact that leaded aviation fuel is no longer in general use.

translations.source: Dr. Toni Moll chọpụtara nje Tubakụlọsis (XDR-TB) nke na-emegide ọgwụ na ngalaba Sawụt Afrịka nke KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.reference: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Toni Moll identified the first case of extensively drug-resistant TB (XDR-TB) in a hospital in the KwaZulu-Natal province of South Africa.

translations.source: N'otu ajụjụ ọnụ, ọ sị na bke ọhụrụ a na enye "oke nsogbu ma bụrụkwa ihe egwu n'ihi ogugo ọnwụ dị elu si na ya abịa."
translations.reference: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
translations.hypothesis: In a statement, the new variant is classified as “a variant of interest due to the high number of mutations and the potential impact on vaccine effectiveness.”

translations.source: Ụfọdụ ndị ọrịa enweela ike ibute ọrịa ahụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ, Dr. Moll cheere, ma ihe dị ka abụọ bụ ndị ọrụ ụlọ ọgwụ.
translations.reference: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
translations.hypothesis: Some patients may have already developed the disease in the hospital, Dr. Moll speculated, and half of them were health care workers.

translations.source: Na otu afo n’abia abia, onye butara nje nwere ibunye ya mmadu 10 ruo 15 n’eru ya nso.
translations.reference: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
translations.hypothesis: In subsequent generations, the index case transmits the virus to 10–15 people.

translations.source: Agbanyeghị, pacentị nke XDR-TB nọ n’ime òtù niile nke ndị nwere ụkwara nta ka yiri ka ọ dị obere; 6,000 nke mpokọta ndị mmadụ 330,000 nwetere ọrịa ahụ n’oge ọ bụla n’ime South Afrịka.
translations.reference: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
translations.hypothesis: However, the proportion of XDR-TB cases within the group of people with HIV is much higher; 6 000 of the 330 000 people who developed the disease in South Africa were infected with XDR-TB.

translations.source: Satịlaịtị ndị ahụ, abụọ nke na-anyị arụ karịa nke gafere paụnd 1,000, ma na-ekwo ọsọ n’ọdịka maịlị kwa awa 17,500, sukọrọ ọnụ maịlị 491 n’elu Eluụwa.
translations.reference: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
translations.hypothesis: The satellites, two of which cost more than $1,000, and orbit the Earth at a speed of 17,500 miles per hour, circle the Earth every 90 minutes.

translations.source: Ndị ọka mmụta sayensị sị na mgbasa nkụkọta isi ahụ butere dị ukwu.
translations.reference: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists say the hole in the ozone layer is getting bigger.

translations.source: Ha ka na anwale ịchọpụta etu ibu mkpọka ahụ dị ma etu ọ ga-esi emetụta Uwa.
translations.reference: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
translations.hypothesis: They are still trying to figure out what the actual weight of the atmosphere is and how it affects the world.

translations.source: United States Strategic Command nke ụlọ ọrụ Ngalaba Nchebe U.S. na-esochi irighiri ihe ahụ.
translations.reference: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
translations.hypothesis: The United States Strategic Command, a department of the U.S. Department of Defense, is in charge of tracking it.

translations.source: A ga-ezìga ozī nyocha nke nkata akpara n'otu weebụsaịtị ọha.
translations.reference: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
translations.hypothesis: The survey form will be made available on the website.

translations.source: Otu dibia-bekee onye rubuuru oru ulo-ogwu umuaka nke pittsburgh, Pennysylvania ka aga ekpe ikpe banyere igbu-mmadu nke akpasuru-iwe ka ahuchara nne ya na azu ugbo-ala na-onwu n’ubochi Wednesde, ka ndi isi no na Ohio kwuru.
translations.reference: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
translations.hypothesis: A pediatrician from Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania is being charged with murder after allegedly killing his wife and mother on Wednesday, according to authorities in Ohio.

translations.source: Ahuru Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, na Blue Ash, Ohio otu sobob di nso 15 miles n’ebe ugwu Cincinnati ka o dine n’ala n’akuku okporouzo naani ihe oyi bu tshirt na uwe ime, otu osi noro gosiri na ono n’okpuru ike ogwu.
translations.reference: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, of Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb about 15 miles north of Cincinnati, was having dinner in a restaurant in the city's central business district when he was fatally wounded in the shooting.

translations.source: Ọ dụrụ ndị ọrụ nche gaa na Oldsmobile Intrigue ojii ya nke nọ n’ụzọukwu narị ise n’itoanya.
translations.reference: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
translations.hypothesis: He led police to his black Oldsmobile Intrigue, which was parked about five blocks away.

translations.source: Achọtara ozu Saroja Balasubramanian, onye dị afọ iri ise na atọ, ebe ahụ, ja akwa mkpuchi kpudoro ya.
translations.reference: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
translations.hypothesis: The body of 53-year-old Saroja Balasubramanian, was discovered there, after she reportedly fell from a bridge.

translations.source: Ndị uwe ojii kwuru na ahụ ahụ dị ka ọ nọọla ebe ahụ ruo ihe dị ka otu ụbọchị.
translations.reference: Police said that the body appeared to have been there for about a day.
translations.hypothesis: Police said the body had been at the scene for about a day.

translations.source: Okwu mbu ndị ahụ nke ọrịa ahụ n'oge a bụ ka a kọrọ n'ime ebe ọgwụgwụ May.
translations.reference: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
translations.hypothesis: The last known cases of the disease were reported in May.

translations.source: Ezi na ebu ọrịa ahụ, nke anwụnta na ebunyezi ndị mmadụ.
translations.reference: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
translations.hypothesis: The actual disease, however, is caused by the parasite Trypanosoma cruzi.

translations.source: Ihe ndaputa a emela ka goomenti mba India bido mebe ihe dika izipu ndi na ejide ezi na mpaghara ometuru hinne, ikesa akwa mgbochi anwu nta makwa igba ogwu na-egbu pesti.
translations.reference: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
translations.hypothesis: The results led the Indian government to initiate a program to eliminate the disease by improving sanitation and spraying insecticides.

translations.source: Ọgwụ mgbochi ensefalitis dị nde kwuru nde ka gọọmenti kwere na nkwa, nke ga-akwado ndị ọrụ ahụike maka afọ na-abịa abịa.
translations.reference: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
translations.hypothesis: The encephalitis vaccine costs tens of millions of dollars more than the government is willing to pay, which will impact the supply of the vaccine for the next few years.

translations.source: E gburu oge ịnye ndị ọrịa kacha metụta n'afọ a ọgwụ mgbochi maka ego adịghị nakwa enwere ọrịa ndị ọzọ ka ya mkpa igbochi.
translations.reference: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
translations.hypothesis: The funding crunch has resulted in fewer doses being available this year, and some countries have had to make difficult choices about which populations to vaccinate.

translations.source: N'afọ 1956 Słania gara Swiden, ebe afọ atọ gasịrị o bidoro ịrụ ọrụ na ụlọ ọrụ nzipu ozi nke Swiden ma bụrụkwa onye isi mbinye.
translations.reference: In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver.
translations.hypothesis: In 1956, Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he started working for the Swedish post office and became a postmaster.

translations.source: O mepụtaara stampụ karịrị 1,000 maka Swidin na mba 28 ndị ọzọ.
translations.reference: He produced over 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.
translations.hypothesis: He designed more than 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.

translations.source: Oru ya bunke amaara nke oma na iti igba ma doo kwa anya nke oma na obu otu nime ndi amaara n’ezinulo nile na ndi philatelist. Ufodu lekwasiri anya nnoo na ichikota oru ya nani.
translations.reference: His work is of such recognized quality and detail that he is one of the very few "household names" among philatelists. Some specialize in collecting his work alone.
translations.hypothesis: His work is well known and he is considered one of the most important figures in modern philately. Some people are now only interested in collecting his work.

translations.source: Stampụ ya nke otu puku bụ “Nnukwu Omume nke Ndị Eze Sweden” ahụ dị ebube nke David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl dere na 2000, nke edepụtara na Akwụkwọ Guiness nke Ndekọ Ụwa.
translations.reference: His 1,000th stamp was the magnificent "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl in 2000, which is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.
translations.hypothesis: Its thousand-page tome "The Comprehensive Guide to the Royal Etiquette of Sweden" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl from 2000 is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.

translations.source: O sokwa na aru ego akwukwo mba di iche iche, otu oru oruru ohuru bu foto Onye isi goomenti Canada etinyeru n’ihu ego ohuru $5 na $100 ndi Canada.
translations.reference: He was also engaged in engraving banknotes for many countries, recent examples of his work including the Prime Ministerial portraits on the front of the new Canadian $5 and $100 bills.
translations.hypothesis: It also features a new portrait of the Canadian Prime Minister on the new $5 and $100 Canadian bills.

translations.source: Mgbe ihe mberde ahụ mechara, e buru Gibson gawa n’ụlọ ọgwụ mana ọ nwụrụ mgbe obere oge gachara.
translations.reference: After the accident occurred, Gibson was transported to a hospital but died shortly afterwards.
translations.hypothesis: After the crash, Gibson was taken to a hospital but died shortly after.

translations.source: Ọkwọ ụgbọ gwongworo ahụ, nke gbara afọ 64, emerụghị ahụ na mkpọka ahụ.
translations.reference: The truck driver, who is aged 64, was not injured in the crash.
translations.hypothesis: The 64-year-old motorcyclist was not hurt in the accident.

translations.source: N'otu ụbọchị ahụ, ebe elekere nke iri na abụọwepụrụ ụgbọ ahụ n'ebe ihe mbere mere.
translations.reference: The vehicle itself was taken away from the scene of the accident at approximately 1200 GMT on the same day.
translations.hypothesis: That day, the bus broke down at 12:30 in the first place.

translations.source: Otu onye na-arụ ọrụ ebe a na-adọba ụgbọala nọ n’akụkụ ebe ihe mberede ahụ mere kwuru si: "E nwere ụmụaka nọ na-eche ịgafe okporo ụzọ ahụ nakwa ha nille nọ na-eti mkpu ma na-ebe akwa."
translations.reference: A person working in a garage near where the accident occurred said: "There were children waiting to cross the road and they were all screaming and crying."
translations.hypothesis: A worker at a car dealership across the street from where the shooting took place said, "There were kids waiting to cross the street and the crosswalk was blinking and beeping."

translations.source: Ha niile gbaghachitere azụ site na ebe ihe mberede okporo ụzọ ahụ mere.
translations.reference: They all ran back from where the accident had happened.
translations.hypothesis: They all returned to base camp without incident.

translations.source: Ihe ndi ozo akpara na Bali bu izoputa ohia ndi ozo di n’uwa na ikee nka n’uzu nwere ike inyere ndi mba n’ebilite aka itoo n’uzo ga-akwusi mmeto ikuku.
translations.reference: Other subjects on the agenda in Bali include saving the world's remaining forests, and sharing technologies to help developing nations grow in less-polluting ways.
translations.hypothesis: Other topics of interest in Bali include the use of space technologies to help developing countries grow sustainably.

translations.source: Ndi U.N. nwekwara olileanya iwepụta ego iji nyere mba niile aka ndị global wọmịn metụtara iji nagide nsogbu o butere.
translations.reference: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
translations.hypothesis: The UN also hopes to raise money to help all countries afford the global public goods needed to fight the next pandemic.

translations.source: Enwere ike iji ego agụ rụọ ụlọ ndị mmiri anaghi ebu, njikwa dọtị ka mma, na ọkụkụ ihe dị iche iche.
translations.reference: The money could go toward flood-proof houses, better water management, and crop diversification.
translations.hypothesis: Money can be used to build roads, dams, schools, and other infrastructure.

translations.source: Fluke dere na mbo ufodu gbara ihu na emechiri onu umunwanyi iji kwusi ha ikwuputa okwu maka ihe gbasara ahuike umu nwanyi agaghi nkeoma.
translations.reference: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful.
translations.hypothesis: Fluke wrote that gagging the mouths of women who dare to speak out against the medical establishment is not the way to improve women’s health.

translations.source: O ruru na mkpebi a n'ihi ọtụtụ okwu nkwado o nwetara n'aka ụmụnwoke ma ụmụnwaanyị ndị sị ya na ọgwụ mgbochi afọ ime bụ ihe kwesịrị ekwesị.
translations.reference: She came to this conclusion due to the multitude of positive comments and encouragement sent to her by both female and male individuals urging that contraception medication be considered a medical necessity.
translations.hypothesis: This decision was supported by many men and women who felt that the ban on contraception was unjust.

translations.source: Oge ya bụ ọgụ gwụchara mgbe e wegara ndị merụrụ ahụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ, ihe dị ka ndị mkpọrọ 40 fọrọ afọ nọọrọ na mpụga, jụ ịlaghachi n'ime ụlọ mkpọrọ ha.
translations.reference: When the fighting ceased after the wounded were transported to the hospital, about 40 of the other remaining inmates stayed in the yard and refused to return to their cells.
translations.hypothesis: The hour was late when the wounded were finally admitted to the hospital, with about 40 prisoners remaining outside, asking to be allowed back into their cells.

translations.source: Ndị mkparịta ụka nwara ịweta udo, mana ihe ndị mkpọrọ chọrọ edoghi anya.
translations.reference: Negotiators tried to rectify the situation, but the prisoners' demands are not clear.
translations.hypothesis: The negotiators wanted to bring peace, but the demands of the captors were unrealistic.

translations.source: N'etiti 10:00 na 11:00 MDT n'abalị, ndị mkpọrọ nọ na mpụta mụnyere ọkụ.
translations.reference: Between 10:00-11:00 pm MDT, a fire was started by the inmates in the yard.
translations.hypothesis: Between 10:00 and 11:00 MDT last night, the hostages were moved to a different building.

translations.source: N'oge na-adịghị anya, ndị ọrụ uwe ojii ejikere na gịa ogbaaghara batara n'ime yad ahụ ma jiri gaasị anya mmiri wee gbakọta ndị mkpọrọ n’otu ebe.
translations.reference: Soon, officers equipped with riot gear entered the yard and cornered the inmates with tear gas.
translations.hypothesis: Shortly after, a team of police and firefighters rappelled from the roof of the building and used a bullhorn to order the hostages to gather in one area.

translations.source: Ndị otu mgbanyụ ọkụ mechara gbanyụọ ọkụ ahụ ebe 11:35 nke abalị.
translations.reference: Fire rescue crews eventually doused the fire by 11:35 pm.
translations.hypothesis: Firefighters finally extinguished the blaze at 11:35 p.m.

translations.source: Mgbe aruchara akwa-mmiri ahu na afo 1963, ewee kwusi udu idemiri ahu nke na agbasa unyi na ahu mmiri ahu nile.
translations.reference: After the dam was built in 1963, the seasonal floods that would spread sediment throughout the river were halted.
translations.hypothesis: When the dam was completed in 1963, the resulting lake flooded the old town and the surrounding area.

translations.source: Sedimenti a dị mkpa maka ịmepụta ụmụ mgbochi ejiri aja mee ma akụkụ osimiri, nke jere ozi dị ka ebe obibi anụ ọhịa.
translations.reference: This sediment was necessary for creating sandbars and beaches, which served as wildlife habitats.
translations.hypothesis: This sediment is necessary for the formation of rocky intertidal shores, which provide habitat for a variety of plants and animals.

translations.source: N’ihi nke ahụ, ụdị azụ abụọ ekpochapụla, ma abụọ ndị ọzọ abụrụla ndị nọ n’ihe ize ndụ, gụnyere humpback chub.
translations.reference: As a result, two fish species have become extinct, and two others have become endangered, including the humpback chub.
translations.hypothesis: As a result, two species have already gone extinct, and two others are critically endangered, including the humpback chub.

translations.source: Agbanyeghi na larịị mmiri ahụ ga-eto elu ụkwụ ole na ole naanị mgbe idei mmiri ahụ gasịrị, ndị isi na-enwe olile anya na ọ ga-ezu iji weghachi ụmụ ugwu aja nke mmiri riri na ndịda ụzọ mmiri.
translations.reference: Although the water level will only rise a few feet after the flood, officials are hoping it will be enough to restore eroded sandbars downstream.
translations.hypothesis: Although the water will only rise a few feet at high tide, officials hope it will be enough to wash away the mud that has been caked on the bottom of the channel.

translations.source: E nwebeghị ịdọ aka na ntị nke ajọ ebili mmiri enyegoro, ma na-ndabere na ụlọ ọrụ jiofiziz Jakarta ahụ, a gaghị adọ aka na ntị nke ajọ ebili mmiri n’ihi na ala ọma jijiji ahụ eruteghị iheachọrọ nke ịdị ukwuu 6.5.
translations.reference: No tsunami warning has been issued, and according to the Jakarta geophysics agency, no tsunami warning will be issued because the quake did not meet the magnitude 6.5 requirement.
translations.hypothesis: Warnings were not issued by the Jakarta Volcanology and Geological Disaster Mitigation Agency as the earthquake did not meet the threshold of 6.5.

translations.source: Agbanyeghị na enweghị ihe n'egosi na a ga-enwe sunami, ndi bi ebe ahụ bidoro tụwa egwu, jiri ọsọ na-ahapụsị ụlọ na ahịa ha.
translations.reference: Despite there being no tsunami threat, residents started to panic and began to leave their businesses and homes.
translations.hypothesis: Although there was no tsunami warning issued, the local population started to evacuate, and closed their businesses.

translations.source: N'agbanyeghi na Winfrey bu anya mmiri n'okwu ije ọma ya, o mere ka ndị ihe ya na-amasị mata nke ọma na ọ ga-alọghachi.
translations.reference: Although Winfrey was tearful in her farewell, she made it clear to her fans she will be back.
translations.hypothesis: Although Winfrey was doubtful about the success of her talk show, she reassured her audience that she would return.

translations.source: “Nke a abụghị ịsị ka e mesịa. Nke a bụ imechi otu isi na imeghe nke ọhụrụ.”
translations.reference: "This is not going to be goodbye. This is the closing of one chapter and the opening of a new one."
translations.hypothesis: "This is not a last resort. This is a head start."

translations.source: Akara nchịkọta ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị obodo egosila na ahọrọgharịrị onye isi obodo nọ n'ọchịchị bụ Hifikepunye Pohamba.
translations.reference: Final results from Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections have indicated that the incumbent president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, has been reelected by a large margin.
translations.hypothesis: The ruling SWAPO party's politburo nominated incumbent president Hifikepunye Pohamba as its presidential candidate.

translations.source: Otu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-achị ugbu a, Sawụt West Afrịka Pịpụls Ọganaịzeshọn (SWAPO), jidekwara ọnọdụ ha dịka otu kacha n'ọnụ ọgụgụ na ntuli aka ndị omeiwu.
translations.reference: The ruling party, South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), also retained a majority in the parliamentary elections.
translations.hypothesis: The current ruling party, the South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), retained its position as the party with the most seats in parliament.

translations.source: Ndị mmekọta na ndị agha Afghan banyere n’ime ebe ahụ ichekwa saịtị ahụ ma ezitela ụgbọ elu ndị mmekọta inyere aka.
translations.reference: Coalition and Afghan troops moved into the area to secure the site and other coalition aircraft have been sent to assist.
translations.hypothesis: Accompanied by Afghan commandos, the coalition forces then secured the site and were assisted by coalition aircraft.

translations.source: Mkpọkasị ahụ mere n'elu ugwu, e kwenyekwara na ọ bụ ya kpatara ajọ ọkụ.
translations.reference: The crash occurred high up in mountainous terrain, and is believed to have been the result of hostile fire.
translations.hypothesis: The explosion happened in the caldera, and is believed to have caused the pyroclastic flows.

translations.source: Mgbalị ị na-achọ saịtị okuku ahụ na-emebi ihu igwe site na ihu igwe dị njọ na ala siri ike.
translations.reference: Efforts to search for the crash site are being met by bad weather and harsh terrain.
translations.hypothesis: The search for the site of the crash is being made more difficult by bad weather and rough seas.

translations.source: Ụlọ ọrụ enyemaka ahụike Mangola, 'Medecines Sans Frontieres', na Wọld Helt Ọganaịzeshọn na-ekwụ na ọ bụ ntiwapụ ọrịa kachasị njọ ahụrụla na mba ahụ.
translations.reference: The medical charity Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres and the World Health Organisation say it is the worst outbreak recorded in the country.
translations.hypothesis: Medical humanitarian organisations Médecins Sans Frontières and the World Health Organization said it was the worst cholera outbreak the country has seen.

translations.source: Onye nkwuchite maka Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman kwuru: "Angola na-agaru maka ntiwapụ ya kacha njọ mgbe ọ bụla ma ọnọdụ ahụ ka dịkwa njọ n’ime Angola,” o kwuru.
translations.reference: Spokesman for Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman said: "Angola is heading for its worst ever outbreak and the situation remains very bad in Angola," he said.
translations.hypothesis: "Angola is already experiencing its worst drought in decades and the situation is likely to worsen in Angola," said Richard Verreydt, MSF operational manager.

translations.source: Egwuregwu ji ihu igwe dị mma bido ebe elekere iri nke ụtụtụ, ewepụ igirigi yọrọ n'ụtụtụ nke gbachara ọsịsọ, ọ bụ ụbọchị zuru oke nye 7's rugbi.
translations.reference: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.
translations.hypothesis: The weather was perfect for a day of outdoor activities, with a light morning mist giving way to clear skies, ideal for a day of rugby.

translations.source: Ndi kachasị elu na asọmpi bu South Africa bidoro na akara nke oma mgbe ha nwere mmeri ntụsara ahụ nke 26 - 00 megide Zambia gbara mkpụrụ nke 5.
translations.reference: Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia.
translations.hypothesis: The top ranked team South Africa started off with a convincing 26 - 00 victory over Zambia in their 5th match.

translations.source: N'agbanyeghị na ọ dị ka ndị na emegide ha bụ ndị ndịda ka ha mma, ndị mba Sawụt Afrịka melitere nwayọ nwayọ ka ịsọ mpi gara n'ihu.
translations.reference: Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed.
translations.hypothesis: Although the Springboks were the better team on the day, the South Africans had improved markedly since the last time the teams had played.

translations.source: Ụzọ mkpachapụ anya ha n’ime mgbochi, ka ha si ejide bọọlụ ma ụzọ nhàzi pụrụ iche mere ha ka ha pụọ iche ma o doro ha anya n’òtù a bụ òtù ha ga-emeri.
translations.reference: Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
translations.hypothesis: Their defense was impenetrable, their ball control exquisite, and their passing accuracy made them a team to be feared.

translations.source: Ndị ọrụ maka obodo nke Amstardam na Ebe ngosi ihe ndị mgbe ochie Anne Frank na-ekwu na osisi ahụ ebutela ọrịa n’iji ero ma dịkwa njọ makka ahụike ọha dịka ha na-agbagha na ọ nọbụrụ n’ezigbo ihe ize ndụ nke ịdapụga n’ofe.
translations.reference: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.
translations.hypothesis: The city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank House said the chestnut tree had become a health hazard with its large, heavy nuts and warned of a risk of falling branches.

translations.source: Akara ya maka mgbututu n'ụbọchị Tuzde, mana azọpụtara ya ka ụlọ ikpe kpegharịrị ikpe na mberede.
translations.reference: It had been scheduled to be cut down on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.
translations.hypothesis: He was arrested on Tuesday but released pending a court appearance.

translations.source: Ụzọ niile dị n'ọgba ahụ a kpọrọ “Ụmụnne nwanyị asaa” dị ihe dịka opekatampe 100 mita ruo mita 250 (fiiti 328 ruo 820) na dayamita.
translations.reference: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.
translations.hypothesis: All of the canyons in this area are V-shaped, and range in size from 100 to 250 m (328 to 820 ft) wide and deep.

translations.source: Ụmụ onyinyo infràreèd na-egosipụta na mgbanwe okpomọkụ ahụ sitere n'ụbọchị na abalị na-egosi na ha nwere ike ịbụ ọgba.
translations.reference: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.
translations.hypothesis: Infrared imagery showed the thermal differences between day and night were not as extreme as they should be, indicating the presence of snow.

translations.source: Ha na-adị oyi karịa gburugburu ha n'ehihie ma dị ọkụ karịa n'abalị.
translations.reference: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.
translations.hypothesis: They are colder than their surroundings at night and warmer during the day.

translations.source: Omume okpomọkụ ha anaghị adịgide ka nnukwu ọgba dị n'ụwa nke na-enwe okpomọkụ na-anaghị agbanwe, mana ọ dị ka ndị a maka na ha bụkwa olulu miri emi n'ime ala," Glen Cushing kwuru, onye United States Geology Survey (USGS) Otu Astrojiọlọji na nke Mahadum Northern Arizona dị na Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.reference: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.hypothesis: Their thermal behavior is not so very different from that of large bodies of water on Earth, but they are more uniform in temperature because they are also in hydrostatic equilibrium," said Glen Cushing, a research scientist with the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Branch and Department of Planetary Sciences at Northern Arizona University in Flagstaff, Arizona.

translations.source: Na mba Frans, ịtụ ụtụ bụ ihe anaghị eji ike eme: ndị na-atụ ụtụ na ewezuga onwe ha n'otu ụlọ ndo, tinye akwụkwọ ebiri na ndịnihu nke na-egosi onye ha na atụrụ ụtụ n'ime akwụkwọ amachiri amachi.
translations.reference: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
translations.hypothesis: In France, the tax is not collected by the state: tax collectors are private individuals who are entitled to keep the difference between the amount they collect and the amount they pay to the state.

translations.source: Ka ndị nchịkọta nyochachara onye na-atụ ụtụ, onye na-atụ ụtụ etinye akwụkwọ ụtụ ya amachiri amachi n'ime igbe nnakọ ụtụ ma bie aka n'akwụkwọ ndị tụrụ ụtụ.
translations.reference: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
translations.hypothesis: Once the collector has verified the payer, the payer completes the payment transaction on the payer's platform and endorses the payment instrument.

translations.source: Iwu gbasara ntuliaka na Frans depụtara usoro ikpe kpọmkwem.
translations.reference: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
translations.hypothesis: Electoral law in France lists specific offenses.

translations.source: Kemgbe 1988, ụmụ igbe ntuli aka ga-abụrịrị ngafe-ahụ-ụzọ ka ndị ntụli aka na ndị nnyota ga-agba akaebe na o nweghị envelopu nọ na ya mgbe a na-ebido ntuli aka nakwa o nweghị envelopu etinyere ewezụga nke ndị agụgwere ọnụ ma nye ikikere nke ọma.
translations.reference: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
translations.hypothesis: Since 1988, ballot boxes have to be transparent so that voters and polling agents can check that they are empty before the start of the poll and that the ballot papers placed in them are those issued to the voters.

translations.source: Ndị a na atụrụ ụtụ nwere ike iziga ndị nnọchiteanya ka ha gbaa ama ihe nile mere. Na mgbede, ndị ọrụ efu ga agụkọ ụtụ nile na oke nlegideanya , ma site n'usoro atọrọ atọ.
translations.reference: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
translations.hypothesis: The accused may send representatives to observe the entire process. Finally, the jurors deliberate and reach a verdict by consensus.

translations.source: ASUS Eee PC, ewepụtara ụwa niile na mbụ maka ụmụ ihe nchekwa-ego na arụmọrụ ya, wụrụ isiokwu na-ewu ewu n’Ọnwa IT Taipei 2007.
translations.reference: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
translations.hypothesis: The ASUS Eee PC, notable for its low cost and energy efficiency, was first introduced to the world at the Taipei IT Month in 2007.

translations.source: Mana ogugo ahịa kọmpụta laptop ga-agbanwe ma dị iche ri nne ka ASUS nwetachara Nturu ugo Taịwan Sọstenebụl Awọdụ n'afọ 2007 site n'aka Ezekutiv Yuan si na Repọblik Chaịna.
translations.reference: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
