translations.hypothesis: However, the laptop market share will be changed and reshuffled as ASUS just received the Taiwan Sustainable Brand Award in 2007 from the Executive Yuan of Republic of China.

translations.source: Webụsaịtị steshọn a kpọrọ ihe ngosi a "ihe ngosi redio ndị mgbe ochie nke osote ya ọhụrụ gbasara ịgba ara akwụkwọ ma dị egwu!"
translations.reference: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
translations.hypothesis: The website called the show "a new take on the old radio show about cops and robbers!"

translations.source: N’oge mbu ya, ihe ngosi a ka egosiputara n’igwe saịtị intaneti na-agba ọsọ nke TogiNet Radio, ebe a lekwasịrị anya na redio na-ekwu okwu.
translations.reference: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.
translations.hypothesis: For its first time, the show was also streamed live on the Togolese social media platform, Togolese Radio, where people could listen to the show live.

translations.source: N'ọgwụgwụ afọ 2015, TogiNet bidoro AstroNet Redio dị ka mpaghara nọ n'okpuru ya.
translations.reference: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
translations.hypothesis: At the end of 2015, Toginet launched AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary.

translations.source: Na mbụ, ihe nkiri ahụ gosipụtara ndị omee olu ka bidoro ebido, ndị si n'ọwụwa anyanwụ Tegzas.
translations.reference: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
translations.hypothesis: The movie originally featured voice actors who were from West Texas.

translations.source: A sị na ozuzu ohi gara n'ihu ogologo abalị niile, n'ihi na ndị ọrụ mmanye iwu anọghị n'okporo ama Bishkek.
translations.reference: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
translations.hypothesis: The protests went on all night, with police nowhere to be seen on the streets of Bishkek.

translations.source: Otu onye nkere anya kọwapụtara Bishkek dịka ihe na-emikpu n'ọnọdụ "ọgba aghara", ka ndị mmadụ na akpagharị na eburughara ngwa ahịa n'ike.
translations.reference: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
translations.hypothesis: One eyewitness described Bishkek as being in a state of "near chaos", with people running and gunshots being fired.

translations.source: Otutu ndi bi na Bishkek tara ndi na-eme ngaghari iwe si na odida anyanwu uta gbasara imebi iwu
translations.reference: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
translations.hypothesis: Many Bishkek residents were outraged by the curfew and protested against it.

translations.source: Mba Sawụtụ Afrịka emeriela Ọl Bụlaksị (Nuu Ziilandị) n'egwuregwu rọgụbi nke Mbanaatọ n'ama egwuregwu Royal Bafokeng nke dị na Rọstenbọgụ, Sawụtụ Afrịka.
translations.reference: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
translations.hypothesis: South Africa has defeated New Zealand in the Rugby World Cup final at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.

translations.source: N'ikpeazụ, otu ọkpụ ka ha jiri merie ha, ha sara ọkpụ iri abụọ na otu ebe ndị mmegide ha sara ọkpụ iri abụọ. Nke a usoro mmeri iri na ise ndị Ọl Blaks na mmechi.
translations.reference: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
translations.hypothesis: In the end, they won by one point, with a score of twenty-one to the other team's twenty. This was the fifteenth win for the Bulls and clinched the series.

translations.source: Maka òtù Springboks ndị ahụ, ọ kwụsịrị na egwuregwu-ise nke ogologo usoro ọdịda.
translations.reference: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
translations.hypothesis: For those Springboks, it was the end of a long goodbye.

translations.source: Ọ bụ ịsọmpi ikpeazụ nke Ọl Blaks ndị merigoro ihe nnweta izu ụka abụọ gara aga.
translations.reference: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
translations.hypothesis: It was the final match of the season for the All Blacks who had won the previous two weeks.

translations.source: A ga-agba egwuregwu ikpeazụ nke ogbe a n'Elis Pak na Johanesbọg n'izu na-abịa abịa, mgbe ndị Sprịngbọks ga-agba Ọstrelia.
translations.reference: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
translations.hypothesis: The last match of the Tri-Nations series will be played at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks will play Australia.

translations.source: Ala ọma jijiji dị larịị mara ọdịda anyanwụ Montana jijiji mgba ojiri nkeji asatọ gafee elekere nke iri n'abalị Monde.
translations.reference: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
translations.hypothesis: Montana earthquake sequence The first earthquake in this sequence occurred at 10:07 p.m. local time on Monday.

translations.source: Mpaghara mba Yunaịted Steeti na-ahụ maka mmegharị ala (USGS) na mpaghara nke na-ezite ozi gbasara ala ọma jijiji enwetabeghị mkpesa ihe mmebi.
translations.reference: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
translations.hypothesis: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake information service reported no damage from the earthquake.

translations.source: Ala ọma jijiji ahụ nwere etiti ya na ihe dị ka km 20 (maịlị 15) ugwu-ebe ugwu ọwụwa anyanwụnke Dillon, na ihe dị ka km 65 (maịlị 40) ndịda nke Butte.
translations.reference: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
translations.hypothesis: The earthquake's focus was about 20 km (15 mi) northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 mi) south of Butte.

translations.source: N'ụbọchị Mọnde, n'ala mpịtọ dị Lyon nso nke dị n'ọwụwa anyanwụ mba Frans, ka achọpụtara na ọrịa gburu otu ọbọgwụ bụ ụdịrị ọrịa nnụnụ nke nwere ike igbu mmadụ, bụ H5N1.
translations.reference: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
translations.hypothesis: On Monday, in a town near Lyon in eastern France, a poultry farm detected an outbreak of a particularly lethal strain of bird flu, H5N1.

translations.source: Frans bụ mba nke asaa n'ọgbakọ Iroopu ịta ahụhụ n'ihi ọrịa a; osotere Ọstrịa, Jemani, Slovenia, Bọlgeria, Gris na Itali.
translations.reference: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
translations.hypothesis: France is the seventh European country to report cases of this infection; the others being Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.

translations.source: Enwere orịa a ka na-enyo enyo ka ọ bụ H5N1na mba Kroeshia na Denmak.
translations.reference: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
translations.hypothesis: There is some evidence that the H5N1 virus may be endemic in poultry in Croatia and Denmark.

translations.source: Chambers gbara Chukwu akwụkwọ maka "ọnwụ zuru ebe niile, mmebi na iyi egwu eyiri nde ka nde mmadụ bi n’ụwa."
translations.reference: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
translations.hypothesis: Chambers charged God with "widespread death, destruction and terror among the inhabitants of the earth."

translations.source: Chambers, onye na-ajụkarị oge niile, na-agbagha na ikpe ya "abaghị uru" ma "onye ọ bụla nwere ike ịkụ onye ọbụla ikpe."
translations.reference: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
translations.hypothesis: Chambers, who is often late, complained that his trial was "unfair" and that "anyone could have prosecuted" him.

translations.source: Akụkọ egosipụtara na opera french, nke Camille Saint-Saens dere, bụ maka onye na-ese ihe "nke ịhụnanya o nwere maka Japan na ọgwụ ike na-achị ndụ ya."
translations.reference: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
translations.hypothesis: The story goes that the French opera composer, Camille Saint-Saëns, dedicated his work to "the memory of a love for Japan and its eternal beauty."

translations.source: N'ihi nke a ndị na-eme ihe ngosi na-ese igbo n'ebe ngosi ihe, ndị nwe ụlọ ngosi ihe na-akwadokwa ndị nlere anya ka ha sonye.
translations.reference: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
translations.hypothesis: Consequently, graffiti artists are often commissioned by property owners, and some art galleries even encourage graffiti artists to display their works.

translations.source: Onye na-ekwubu okwu n'ụlọ omeiwu bụ Newt Gingrich, onye isi obodo Tekzas bụ Rik Perị, na onye otu nzukọ omeiwu Mishel Bakmann mechara gba ndị anọ, ise na isii, n'usoro.
translations.reference: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
translations.hypothesis: The speakers were Newt Gingrich, former Governor of Texas Rick Perry, and Congressman Michele Bachmann, speaking in that order.

translations.source: Ka akara omume pụtara, Gingrich kelere Santorum, mana ọ gwara Rọmni okwu ike, n'ihi ụdịrị mkpọsa ozi ọ kpọsara megide Gringrich na Ayowa.
translations.reference: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
translations.hypothesis: As expected, Gingrich came out swinging at Santorum, but he also had some harsh words for Romney, because of the negative ads Romney's campaign had run against Gingrich in Iowa.

translations.source: Perry kwuru na ọ ga "agaghachị Tekzas ileba anya n'akara omume abalị a, ịchọpụta ma o nwere ọganihu n'ọsọ ahụ", ma na omechara kwuo na ọ ga anọgide n'ọsọ ma sọọ mpi izizi na Karolaina n'ụbọchị nke iri abụọ na otu nke ọnwa Jenụwarị.
translations.reference: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
translations.hypothesis: Perry said he would "go back to Texas and spend the night there, and see if I can make any progress on the race," and then added that he would continue the race and make the first pit stop in Carolina on the 21st of January.

translations.source: Bakman, onye meriri Ntuliaka Ames Strọ n'Ọgọọst, kpebiri ịkwụsị kampen ya.
translations.reference: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.hypothesis: Bakman, who won Ames' special election in August, decided to end his campaign.

translations.source: E bugara onye ahụ na-ese fòto na Ụlọ Ọgwụ Reagan UCLA, ebe o mechara nwụọ.
translations.reference: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
translations.hypothesis: The photographer was taken to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he later died.

translations.source: A kọbụrụ na ọ nọ n’ime ụmụ afọiri abụọ ya. N’otu nkwupụta, Bieber siri "Agbanyeghị na ọ nọghị ma ọ sonyeghị ozugbo ọdachi ihe mberede okporo ụzọ a, echiche na ekpere m nonyere ezinụlọ ndị onye a tara ahụhụ."
translations.reference: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
translations.hypothesis: He is believed to be in his early twenties. In a statement, Bieber said, "Although I wasn’t directly involved in this accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."

translations.source: Webụsaịtị akụkọ ntụrụndụ TMZ ghọtara onye na-ese fòto ahụ kwụsịrị ụgbọala ya n'akụkụ nke ọzọ nke okporo ámá Sepulveda sara mbara nwere ụmụ osisi akwụwara n'akụkụ ya ma nwaa ị see fòto nkwụsị ndị uwe ojii tupu ya agafee okporo ụzọ wee gaa n'ihu, na-akpali onye uwe ojii Njeghari ilekota Nnukwu okporo ụzọ anya nke California na-eduzi okporo ụzọ iji nyeghachi ya iwu gafeghachị , ugboro abụọ.
translations.reference: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
translations.hypothesis: TMZ reported the photographer was standing on the shoulder of a busy stretch of Sepulveda Boulevard with palm trees and tried to take a photo of the police stop before driving off and continuing down the street, prompting the police officer to pursue him down the California freeway, twice.

translations.source: Dị ka ndị uwe ojii kwuru, ọkwụ ụgbọ ala ahụ suru onye na-ese fòto eleghị anya ọ gaghị enwe ebubo mpụ ọ bụla.
translations.reference: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
translations.hypothesis: According to the police, the driver of the car was not at fault and will not be charged with any crime.

translations.source: Ya na naanị medaal iri na asatọ dị kwa otu ụbọchị, ọtụtụ mba adala imepụta ikpo okwu medaal ahụ.
translations.reference: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
translations.hypothesis: With only 18 medals awarded each day, many countries struggle to win even a single medal.

translations.source: Ha gụnyere mba Nedalands, ebe Anna Jochemsen gbara onye nke itoolu n'egwuregwu nkwụmọtọ ụmụ nwanyị nke asọmpi Super-G ụnyaahụ, na Fịnland ebe Katja Saarinen gbara onye nke iri n'otu egwuregwu ahụ.
translations.reference: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
translations.hypothesis: They included the Netherlands, where Anna Jochemsen finished 1st in the women's super-G, and Finland, where Katja Saarinen finished 10th in the same event.

translations.source: Michel Gọrli gbachara Super-G nkwụmọtọ ụmụ nwoke dịka onye nke iri na otu. Oldrich Jelinek, onye Chek rịpọblik gbara onye nke iri na isii na Super-G ọnụnọ ala ụmụ nwoke.
translations.reference: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Michel Goerlich of France finished 11th in the men's super-G. Oldrich Jelinek of the Czech Republic was 12th in the men's super-G.

translations.source: Arly Velaskwez, onye Megziko, gbara onye nke iri na ise na Supa-G ịnọ ọdụ nke ụmụ nwoke. Adam Họl, onye Niu Ziland, gbara onye nke itoolu na Supa-G nkwụmọtọ ụmụ nwoke.
translations.reference: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Arly Velásquez, from Mexico, finished fifth in the women's race. Adam Holley, from New Zealand, finished ninth in the men's race.

translations.source: Onye Poland kpuri isi bụ Maciej Krezel na-egwu egwuregwu ski, na onye ndu ya Anna Ogarzynska mechara onye nke iri na atọ na asọm mpi Supa-G. Jong Seork Park onye South Korea mechara onye nke iri abụọ na ano na asọm mpi ụmụnwoke Super-G.
translations.reference: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Poland's Maciej Krezel was the fastest in the men's super-G, followed by South Korea's Jong Seok Park in second and Italy's Mattia Casse in third.

translations.source: Ndị nchekwa udo UN, ndị lọtara n’ime Haịti mgbe ala ọma jijiji 2010 gachara, bụ ndị a na-ata ụta maka nkesa ọrịa ahụ nke malitere n’akụkụ kampụ ndị agha ahụ.
translations.reference: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
translations.hypothesis: The UN peacekeepers, who have been in Haiti since the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the outbreak by some in the country.

translations.source: Na-ndabere n’ikpe ahụ, ehichaghị ọfụma mkpofu si na kampụ UN, nke na-akpata nje ịbanye nna nwaghara ụzọ nke osimiri Artibonite, otu n’ime nke Haịti kachasị ibu.
translations.reference: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
translations.hypothesis: Based on the claim, the leak from the UN compound is contaminating the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's longest rivers.

translations.source: Tupu ndị agha abịarute, Haiti ezutebeghị nsogbu ndị metụtara ọrịa ahụ kemgbe oge ndị 1800.
translations.reference: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
translations.hypothesis: Before the military intervention, Haiti had not faced any cholera outbreaks since the early 1800s.

translations.source: Ụlọọrụ ikpe na ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya na Haiti atụjela aka n'ọmụmụ sị na ndị agha udo UN nke Nepal bubatara ọrịa na Nepal n'amaghị ama.
translations.reference: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.hypothesis: Haitian authorities and the UN have rejected accusations that a Nepali peacekeeper has started an outbreak of cholera in Nepal.

translations.source: Danielle Lantagne, otu onye ọkachamara UN n’ọrịa ahụ, kwuru na ntiwapụ ahụ bụ ndị na-eme ụdọ nwere ike ịkpata ya.
translations.reference: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
translations.hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, a medical specialist with the UN, said the evacuations were the right decision.

translations.source: Hamilton kwetere na Ụlọ ọgwụ Mahadum Howard nabatara onye ọrịa ahụ n’ọnọdụ ahụ kwụsiri ike
translations.reference: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
translations.hypothesis: Hamilton confirmed that Howard University Hospital accepted the patient in stable condition

translations.source: Onye ọrịa ahụ agabuola na Naịjirịa, ebe a na-enwela ụfọdụ ndị bu nje Ebola ahụ.
translations.reference: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
translations.hypothesis: The patient had been in Nigeria, where there have been some cases of Ebola.

translations.source: Ụlọ ọgwụ ahụ esorola ìwuùsòrò maka njikwa ọrịa ofufe, gụnyere iwepụta iche onye ọrịa ahụ site na ndị ọzọ iji gbochie mbufe ndị ọzọ ọrịa nwere ike ime.
translations.reference: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
translations.hypothesis: The hospital has experience in managing cholera cases, including implementing infection prevention control measures to limit further spread of the disease.

translations.source: Tupu Simpsons Simon Ahụ arụọla ọrụ n’ọtụtụ ihe nkiri n’ọkwa dị iche iche.
translations.reference: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
translations.hypothesis: Before The Simpsons, Simon played many roles in various films.

translations.source: N'afọ ndị 1980, ọ rụrụ ọrụ n'ihe ngosi dị ka Tagzi, Cheers, ya na ihe ngosi Tresi Ullman.
translations.reference: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
translations.hypothesis: In the 1980s, he had roles in shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracey Ullman Show.

translations.source: Na 1989 ọ nyere aka na mmepụta The Simpsons ya na Brooks na Groening, ọ bụ ya hụrụ maka ịwe ndị otu edemede mbụ nke ihe nkiri a.
translations.reference: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
translations.hypothesis: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and he was responsible for hiring the show's original team of writers.

translations.source: N'agbanyeghi na ọ hapụrụ ihe ngosi a n'afọ 1993, ọ ka jidere ọkwa onye isi mmepụta ya, gaa n'ihu na-anara ọtụtụ nde dọla iri kwa sizin n'ụgwọ royalti.
translations.reference: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
translations.hypothesis: Although he sold his interest in the show in 1993, he continued to earn several million dollars a year in royalties.

translations.source: Ụlọ ọrụ mgbasa ozi ndị Chaịna n’oge mbụ kọrọ maka ụgbọ elu a chọrọ izuru.
translations.reference: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
translations.hypothesis: Chinese media initially reported the intended flight path of the aircraft.

translations.source: Ozi ndị ọzọ mechara bata kwuru na ụgbọ elu ahụ natara iyi ụjọ gbasara ogbunigwe ya mere o ji wee lọghachi Afganistan, lotuo na Kandahar.
translations.reference: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.
translations.hypothesis: Subsequent reports said the aircraft had received a warning about its fuel and had been heading back to Kandahar, Afghanistan.

translations.source: Mkpesa mbụ kwuru na achụghachiri ụgbọelu ahụ azụ gawa Afghanistan mgbe anapụrụ ya ikikere ịfedà na mberede n’Ürümqi.
translations.reference: The early reports say the plane was diverted back to Afghanistan after being denied an emergency landing in Ürümqi.
translations.hypothesis: Initial reports suggested the aircraft had been heading back to Afghanistan when it was forced to land in Urumqi.

translations.source: Ihe mberede ụgbọ elu, na-eme ọtụtụ mgbe na mba Aịran, nke nwere ụgbọ elu ndị agha na ndị nkịtị kara nka nke anaghị eleọkọta anya nke ọma.
translations.reference: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
translations.hypothesis: The air crash, which occurred in Iran, involved a military and civilian aircraft in close proximity to each other.

translations.source: Ntarama-ahuhu nke mba uwa putara na agaghi azutali ugbo-elu ohuru.
translations.reference: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
translations.hypothesis: Global warming means that new areas will be opened up.

translations.source: Na mbido izu a, helịkọpta ndị uwe ojii kpọkasịrị gbuo mmadụ atọ ma merụọ mmadụ atọ ọzọ ahụ.
translations.reference: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
translations.hypothesis: Earlier this week, three people were killed and three others injured when a police helicopter opened fire.

translations.source: N’ọnwa gara aga Iran hụrụ ihe ọdachi ikuku ya kachasị njọ n’ọtụtụ afọ mgbe otu ụgbọ elu na-aga Amenịa kpọkara, na-egbu ndị 168 nọ n’ime ya.
translations.reference: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
translations.hypothesis: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in more than a decade when a jet en route to Armenia crashed, killing all 168 people on board.

translations.source: N'otu ọnwa ahụ ka ụgbọ elu ọzọ na Mashhad si n'ụzọ ya gbapụ sụnye isi na mgbidi, were gbuo mmadụ iri na asaa.
translations.reference: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
translations.hypothesis: That same month, a bus in Mashhad crashed into a wall, killing 17 people.

translations.source: Erosmit akagbuola ihe ngosi ha fọdụrụ na njem ha.
translations.reference: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
translations.hypothesis: Eros had destroyed all of their previous recordings.

translations.source: Bandị rọk ahụ tozuru oke ịga njem nleta na United States na Kanada ruo Septemba 16.
translations.reference: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
translations.hypothesis: The band is scheduled to play concerts in the United States and Canada through September 16.

translations.source: Ha kagburu njem ngagharị ahụ mgbe onye isi ịgụ egwu Steven Tyler merụrụ ahụ mgbe ọ si n’ebedielu dapụ dị ka ọ na eme emume ngosi na Ọgọst 5.
translations.reference: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
translations.hypothesis: The band canceled the rest of the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler injured himself on stage on August 5.

translations.source: Emeriri Murray na seti nke mbu na ndorondoro njirimara onye mmeri mgbe umu nwoke abuo jidere bolu ọ bụla n’ime setị.
translations.reference: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
translations.hypothesis: Murray won the first set 6–4 after breaking serve once.

translations.source: Del Potro nwere uru dị oge na seetị nke abụọ, mana nke a kwa chọrọ ịchọpụta onye mmeri mgbe eruchara 6-6.
translations.reference: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
translations.hypothesis: Del Potro had a match point in the second set, but also had to save a match point at 6-6 in the third.

translations.source: Potro natara nlekota na ubu ya n’oge a mana were ike laghachi azu n’egwuregwu ahu.
translations.reference: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
translations.hypothesis: Potro had a concussion in the game but was able to return to the game.

translations.source: Ihe omume bidoro n’elekere 8:30 nke ụtụtụ. oge mpaghara (15.00 UTC).
translations.reference: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
translations.hypothesis: The event started at 8:30 local time (15.00 UTC).

translations.source: Ndị ọgụ egwu ama ama n’obodo niile bụkuru bhajan, maọbụ abụ ofufe, nye ụkwụ Shri Shyam.
translations.reference: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.
translations.hypothesis: Popular folk songs of the region are bhajans, or devotional songs, dedicated to Lord Krishna.

translations.source: Onye ọgụ egwu Sanju Sharma bidoro na mgbede, Jai Shankar Choudhary were sote ya. Ọ gụkwara chhappan bhog bhajan. Onye ọgụ egwu Raju Khandelwal sonyekwara ya.
translations.reference: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.hypothesis: The show started with a late-night singer, Jai Shankar Choudhary, taking to the stage. He was accompanied by 56 singers and instrumentalists. Singer Raju Khandelwal also joined him on stage.

translations.source: Lakkha Singh wee bido idu n'ịbụ abụ bajan gasị.
translations.reference: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
translations.hypothesis: Lakkha Singh then started singing a Rajasthani song.

translations.source: Efere 108 nke Chhappan Bhog (na okpukpe Hindu, ihe erimeri 56 dị iche iche, dị ka, swiiti, mkpụrụ osisi, akị, nri dị iche iche wdg. Nke e ji achụrụ chi aja) ka e ji wee nye Baba Sham onyinye.
translations.reference: 108 plates of Chhappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different edible items, like, sweets, fruits, nuts, dishes etc. which are offered to deity) were served to Baba Shyam.
translations.hypothesis: 108 cups of Chappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different sweets, such as jalebi, barfi, rasgulla, sandesh, etc. are offered to the deities) were offered to Baba Sham.

translations.source: Lakkha Singh gosirikwara chhappan bhog bhajan. Oguegwu, Raju Khandelwal nọ na-esonye ya.
translations.reference: Lakkha Singh presented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.hypothesis: Lakkha Singh also performed 56 wedding songs. The band was accompanied by Raju Khandelwal on the drums.

translations.source: Na nguputa isi okwu ubochi Tozdee maka Ihe ngosi Egwuregwu Tokyo, onye isi Nintendo Satoru Iwata kpughere controller design ulo oru ya maka njikwa ohuru Nintendo Revolution.
translations.reference: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.
translations.hypothesis: At a press conference to announce the lineup of events for the upcoming Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled his company's new controller design for the upcoming Nintendo Revolution console.

translations.source: Ngwa Kọntrola, nke yiri rimotu onyonyo, na-eji ihe mmetụta abụọ dị n'akụkụ onyonyo achọpụta ọnọdụ ya n'oghere ọbụla nwere akụkụ atọ.
translations.reference: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.
translations.hypothesis: The Control Stick, which looks a bit like a TV remote control, uses two sensors on the bottom of the stick to detect its position relative to the three base stations.

translations.source: Nke a ga-ekwe ka ndị na-egwu egwuregwu jikwaa ihe omume na njegharị n'egwuregwu vidiyo site na imegharị ngwa ọrụ ahụ n'ikuku.
translations.reference: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.
translations.hypothesis: This allows players to control the action and movement in the video game by manipulating the device in the air.

translations.source: Giancarlo Fisichella ejikwalighi ụgbọ ala ya wee si n'ọsọ ahụ pụọ n'isi mmalite ya.
translations.reference: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.
translations.hypothesis: Giancarlo Fisichella was the first to retire from the race, spinning his car around at the start.

translations.source: Onye otu ya Fenando Alonso nọ n'isi ọsọ ọtụtụ mgbe, mana nke ahụ kwụsịrị mgbe ọ kwụsịrị ụgbọala ya, o nwere ike ịbụ n'ihi ụkwụ ihu ụgbọala a na-etinyeghi nke ọma.
translations.reference: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
translations.hypothesis: Teammate Fernando Alonso also had a front suspension failure, though he was able to bring his car to a stop safely.

translations.source: Michael Schumacher kwụsịrị ọsọ ya n’oge na-etoghị anya mgbe Alonso mesịrị, n’ihi mmebi sọspenshọn n’ime ọtụtụ agha n’ime oge ọsọ ahụ.
translations.reference: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
translations.hypothesis: Schumacher had already retired from the race earlier in the season after an accident-filled race in Monaco.

translations.source: Dịka edemede nzukọ nta akụkọ ahụ kwuru, "ọ sị na ọ mara oke mma ma mara ka esi agụ egwu ọfụma".
translations.reference: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
translations.hypothesis: According to the press conference, he said he was "surprised and flattered".

translations.source: Ọ metụtara m n'ala ala obi m mgbe ọbụla anyị mere mmegharị nkwado maka nke a.
translations.reference: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."
translations.hypothesis: It always touched me deeply when we did fundraising for this cause.

translations.source: K’oforo nkeji 3 ka ha fenyie, igwefoto no n’ime ugbo ahu gosirika otutu foam n’ekpuchi ihe kewapuru na tanki mmanu.
translations.reference: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.
translations.hypothesis: 30 minutes later, a photo from the scene showed a large plume of smoke rising from the fuel tank area.

translations.source: N’agbanyegghị, echeghị na ha kpatara mmebi ọ bụla n’ụgbọ njem ahụ.
translations.reference: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.
translations.hypothesis: However, they are not believed to have caused any damage to the vehicle.

translations.source: Onye isi ihe mmemme shọtụl NASA bụ Wayne Hale Jr. kwuru na fom ahụ dara "mgbe oge anyị na-ele anya gasịrị."
translations.reference: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
translations.hypothesis: The NASA mission director, Wayne Hale Jr., said the orbiter "disintegrated" as it passed over the viewing area.

translations.source: Ka nkeji ise gachara e bidoro ihe ngosi a, ikuku ebido kuwe, ka nkeji ọzọ gachara, ikuku a na-eru ọsọ kilomita 70 kwa awa... mmiri ebido zowe, mana o ji iwe bịa, ụdịrị iwe na-eme ka ọ na-adụ gị adụ ka ntu, mkpụrụ mmiri ebido zowe, ndị mmadụ a na-agbagharị, na-atụ egwu, na-eti mkpu.
translations.reference: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
translations.hypothesis: Five minutes later the show started, the wind picked up, and a minute later the wind was up to 70 miles per hour... Raindrops began to fall, and then the hail came, a stinging, needle-like ice that made people scream and shout, and run for cover.

translations.source: Nwanne m nwanyị na enyi ya nwụrụ, na dịka m na-aga n'ụzọ, enwere ndị mmadụ abụọ nwere nkwarụ, ndị mmadụ a na-arị ha elu, na-akwagharị ha," Amand Vesachi kwuru.
translations.reference: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
translations.hypothesis: My sister and her friend were killed, and as I went to the scene, I saw two people with machetes, people were running, screaming," Amand Vashchi said.

translations.source: NHK kwukwara na ulo oru nuklia power plant nke Kashiwazaki Kariwa di na mpaghara Niigata n’aru oru ofuma.
translations.reference: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
translations.hypothesis: NHK also said that the Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata Prefecture was no longer operational.

translations.source: Hokuriku Electrik Pawa Co. zitere ozi na ala ọma jijiji emebighi ihe n'igwe ọkụ nke izizi na nke abụọ n'ụlọ ọrụ ike nuklia dị na Shika nke emechiri emechi.
translations.reference: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.hypothesis: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported that the magnitude 6.0 earthquake that hit the Shika nuclear power plant compound earlier in the day caused no damage to the plant's first and second reactors.

translations.source: A kọrọ na ụfọdụ ebeobibi dị 9400 na mpaghara ahụ nọ na-enweghị mmiri ma ihe dị ka 100 na-enweghị ọkụ eletriki.
translations.reference: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
translations.hypothesis: It is reported that 9400 inhabited areas in the region do not have access to clean water and about 100 do not have electricity.

translations.source: O mebiri ụfọdụ ụzọ, kwụsịtụ njem ụgbọ oloko n'ebe ndị o metụtara, ma ọdụ ụgbọelu Ishikawa ka mechiri emechi.
translations.reference: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
translations.hypothesis: It blocked some roads, suspended train services in the affected areas, and Ishikawa Airport remained closed.

translations.source: Otu ogbunigwe gbawara n'ezi ụlọ ọrụ onye isi ọchịchị.
translations.reference: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
translations.hypothesis: A bomb exploded near the prime minister's office.

translations.source: Ogbunigwe atọ ọzọ gbara na nsonso ụlọ gọọmenti gasị n'ime awa abụọ.
translations.reference: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
translations.hypothesis: Three more rockets hit near the government building in the following two hours.

translations.source: Akụkọ ụfọdụ sịrị na mmadụ asatọ nwụrụ, ma akụkọ gọọmenti sị na ihe ruru mmadụ iri atọ merụrụ ahụ; ma na amatabeghị ọnụ ọgụgụ ikpeazụ.
translations.reference: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
translations.hypothesis: Some reports say 8 people died, and government reports say 30 were injured; the final death toll is unknown.

translations.source: A chọpụtara ma sayanọriki asidi ma melamini na mamịrị anụụlọ ndị nwụrụ ka ha richara nri anụụlọ merụrụ emerụ.
translations.reference: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
translations.hypothesis: Acrylamide and melamine were detected in some infant formula products that had been contaminated with ergotamine.

translations.source: Ndị nchọpụta na mahadum sị na ihe ndị a na-emekorịta imepụta mkpụrụ nwere ike ịkwụsị ọrụ akụrụ.
translations.reference: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists at the university said the compound can stop cancer cells from multiplying.

translations.source: Ndị nnyocha ahụ chọpụtara na ọ kpụrụ okwute mgbe e tinyere melamin na siyanurik asid n'ime amịrị buusu.
translations.reference: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
translations.hypothesis: The investigators found that the melamine and cyanuric acid had combined to form insoluble crystals in the cows' kidneys.

translations.source: Ngwakọta nke kristal ndị a dị ka ndị a hụrụ n'amịrị ụmụ anụmanụ ụlọ ndị emetụtara, ma e jiri infrared spektroskopi (FTIR) lee ya.
translations.reference: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.hypothesis: Aggregates of these crystals have been found in the lesions of infected domestic animals, and examined by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).

translations.source: Amaghị m ma Ị matara nke a ma ọ dịghị, mana ọtụtụ ngwaahịa si Sentral Amerịka batara n'obodo a n'akwụghị ụgwọ mbubata.
translations.reference: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
translations.hypothesis: You may or may not know this, but many products from Central America come to this country duty-free.

translations.source: Ma a nara ụtụ isi pasentị iri asatọ na ngwaahịa anyị site na ụmụ tarifu na mba Keetiti Amerịka. anyị na-eleta gị anya.
translations.reference: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
translations.hypothesis: And if you're getting 80% of your revenue from one region, we're going to ask you some very difficult questions.

translations.source: Ọ dịghị m n'anya ka ihe kwesịrị ekwesị; ọ bụghị ezi ihe n'ezie.
translations.reference: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
translations.hypothesis: I don't think it's fair; it's not right.

translations.source: Naanị ihe m na-agwa ndị mmadụ bụ na gị meso anyị etu anyị si emeso gị.
translations.reference: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.hypothesis: The only thing I tell people is to treat me the way you want to be treated.

translations.source: Gọvanọ California Arnold Schwarzenegger tiri iwu nke machibidoro iresi ụmụaka maọbụ ịgbazinye ha egwuregwu vidio ihe ike.
translations.reference: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.hypothesis: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed a law that makes it illegal to sell or give violent video games to minors.

translations.source: Iwu ahụ chọrọ ka egwuregwu vidio ime ihe ike ndị e rere na steeti California ka a mapanye mmewe na-agụpụta "18" na ha ma mere ka ntaramahụhụ maka orire ha nye nwata bụrụ $1000 kwa ịda iwu.
translations.reference: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.hypothesis: The law requires that violent video games sold in California display a label warning that they contain material intended for audiences 18 and older and makes the first offense punishable by a $1,000 fine.

translations.source: Onye nchịkwa Amamikpe n'ihu ọha, Kier Stama QC, kwuru okwu n'ụtụtụ a ikwusa amamikpe Huhne na Pryce.
translations.reference: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
translations.hypothesis: The public prosecutor, Keir Starmer QC, gave his closing speech earlier today in the trial of Huhne and Pryce.

translations.source: Huhne agbaala arukwaghi ma onye ga anochi ya na otu ndi oso-eze achi bu Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP ka ana atu-anya ka owere oru onye ozi azumahia Davey na apu-apu.
translations.reference: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne was supported by his deputy, and the Liberal Democrat leadership candidate, Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is also being considered as a possible replacement for Davey in the coalition.

translations.source: Ahazirioge Huhne na Pryce ibia n’ihu oka ikpe n’ulo ikpe nke Westiminster Magistrates Court ubochi onwa Februari ga di na 16.
translations.reference: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne and Pryce-Jones are due to appear at Westminster Magistrates' Court on February 16.

translations.source: Ndị nwụrụ na ya bụ Nicholas Alden, dị afọ 25, na Zachary Cuddeback, dị afọ 21. Cuddeback bụ ya nọ na-anya ụgbọ.
translations.reference: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
translations.hypothesis: The deceased were identified as 25-year-old Nicholas Alden and 21-year-old Zachary Cuddeback. Cuddeback was the one driving the vehicle.

translations.source: Edgar Veguilla merụrụ ahụ n'aka na n'agba ma Kristoffer Schneider bụ onye mmerụ ahụ ya ga-ewe ihe ọwụwa maka ihu ya.
translations.reference: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.
translations.hypothesis: Edgar Veguilla suffered a concussion and a broken nose, while Kristoffer Schneider sustained a facial fracture that will require surgery.

translations.source: Ngwa agha Uka dara dị ka ọ tụwara ya n’isi ony nke ise. Schneider nwere ụfụ ka na-afụ, anya ọkpụkpọ n’otu anya, akụkụ okpokoro isi furu efu na ihu arụgharịrị site na taịtenọm.
translations.reference: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.
translations.hypothesis: The Uka's war machine was down to its fifth and final reserve. Schneider had a broken nose, a black eye, a split lip and a chin that was being held together by stitches.

translations.source: Schnaida ji ihe vidiyo si na ọnọdụ USAF kwupụta okwu.
translations.reference: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.
translations.hypothesis: Schneier commented on video from the scene, posted by a US Air Force base.

translations.source: N’ofe mmemme Wednesdee ahụ, Carpanedo zọrọ asọmpi n’ọsọ ụgbọala abụọ n’Asọmpi Iko ahụ.
translations.reference: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
translations.hypothesis: At the Wednesday event, Carpanedo competed in the Soapbox Derby.

translations.source: Nke mbụ ya bụ Slalom ahụ, ebe o ritara otu Agbachaghị n'ọsọ mbụ ya. Mmadụ 36 n'ime 116 sọrọ mpi ahụ nwetara otu ihe ahụ n'ọsọ ahụ.
translations.reference: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
translations.hypothesis: His first was a slalom, in which he won first place. 36 of the 116 competitors in the race had the same result.

translations.source: N'ọsọ ya nke ọzọ, Giant Slalom, ọ gbachara dị ka onye nke iri n'otu ụmụ nwanyị nọ ọdụ ebe oge ọsọ ya niile bụ nkeji 4: 41.30, nke ji nkeji 2: 11.60 nọrọ n'azụ onye nke mbụ Claudia Loesch onye Austria ma jiri nkeji 1: 09.02 nọrọ n'azụ Gyöngyi Dani onye Hungary gbara onye nke itoolu.
translations.reference: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
translations.hypothesis: In her next run, the Giant Slalom, she placed 10th with a time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 behind Austrian Claudia Loesch who won and 1:09.02 behind Hungary's Gyöngyi Dani who placed third.

translations.source: Skiers anọ nwanyị nọ n'otu ụmụ nwanyị dara ịgbacha ọsọ ha, na 45 n'ime skiers 117 nọ na Giant Slalom dara isonye na ndị gbatara ihe n'egwuregwu ahụ.
translations.reference: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
translations.hypothesis: Four female skiers and 45 of the 117 male giant slalom starters failed to finish the race.

translations.source: Ndị uwe ojii Madhya Pradesh weghachitela nkùnụkwụ na ekwentị kengagharị ndị e zuru n'ohi.
translations.reference: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
translations.hypothesis: The Madhya Pradesh police have seized a consignment of illegally manufactured mobile phones.

translations.source: Onye na-esote Onye Isi Ndị Uweojii bụ D K Arya kwuru sị, "Anyị anwụchiela mmadụ ise ndị dinara n'ike nwanyị Swiss ahụ ma napụtakwa ekwentị na nkùnụkwụ ya".
translations.reference: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
translations.hypothesis: The Deputy Chief of Police, D.K. Arya, said, "We have arrested five people who were involved in the attack on the Swiss national and recovered the stolen items, including the watches."

translations.source: Ndị eboro ebubo bụ Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar na Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.reference: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.hypothesis: The accused are Baba Kanjar, Bhuta Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaja Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.

translations.source: Onye isi ndị uweojii Chandra Shekhar Solanki sị na ndị eboro ebubo kpuchiri ihu bịa n'ụlọ ikpe.
translations.reference: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
translations.hypothesis: Police chief Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused were produced in court wearing masks.

translations.source: Obu eziokwu na mmadu ato no nime ulo ahu mgbe ugbo-ala ahu kuru ya, onweghi onye nime ha meruru ahu.
translations.reference: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.
translations.hypothesis: The only people who had ever lived in the house when the property was developed were not interested.

translations.source: N'agbanyeghị nke a, onye ọkwọ ụgbọ merụrụ ezigbo ahụ n'isi.
translations.reference: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.
translations.hypothesis: The driver, however, sustained a serious head injury.

translations.source: E mechiri nwa oge okporo ụzọ ahụ ebe ihe mberede mere ebe ndị ọrụ mberede tọhapụrụ onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala ahụ site na Audi TT na-acha uhie.
translations.reference: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
translations.hypothesis: The road was closed for a short time while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.

translations.source: Ọ nọbu n'ụlọ ọgwụ Jems Pajet dị na Gret Yamawụt.
translations.reference: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
translations.hypothesis: He was taken to James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.

translations.source: E mechara kwagarịa ya n’Ụlọ ọgwụ Addenbrooke na Kembriji.
translations.reference: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
translations.hypothesis: He was later transferred to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.

translations.source: Adekọya anọrọla n'Ụlọ ikpe Obodo Edịnbọg ebe eboro ya ebubo maka igbu nwa ya nwoke.
translations.reference: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
translations.hypothesis: She has already been charged with murder at the Edinburgh Sheriff Court.

translations.source: Atụrụ ya nga ma na-eche ikpe, mana akụkọ ọgba ama ọbụla nwere ike ịbụ nke rụrụ arụ n'ihi na ebipụtara onyonyo ya ọfụma.
translations.reference: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
translations.hypothesis: He was arrested and charged, but any resulting criminal case was unlikely to be prosecuted given the statute of limitations.

translations.source: Nke a bụ omume a na-ahụkarị ebe ndị ọzọ na UK mana íkpé íkpē Scottish na-arụ ọrụ n'ụzọ dị iche ma ụlọ ikpe eleela mbipụta nke fotò gasị dị ka ihe nwere ike ịbụ ajọ mbunobi.
translations.reference: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
translations.hypothesis: This is a common scam in other parts of the UK but Scottish police are taking action and have successfully prosecuted people for printing and distributing these fake notes.

translations.source: Ọkachamara Pamela Ferguson nke Mahadum Dundee kwuru "ndị nta akụkọ dị ka ndị na-aga ije n'ebe dị oke egwu ma ọ bụrụ na ha ebipụta foto na ihe ndị ọzọ nke ndị a na-enyo enyo."
translations.reference: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
translations.hypothesis: "Reporters are like aid workers in that they put themselves in harm's way in order to bring us the stories and images that others want to hide," said Pamela Ferguson, a media expert from Dundee University.

translations.source: Ụlọ ọrụ Krawn, nke nọ n'isi amamikpe, agwala ndị nta akụkọ na ha agaghị ekwu okwu gbasara okwu akpụ n'ọnụ ozo ruo mgbe amara mmadụ ikpe.
translations.reference: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.
translations.hypothesis: The Crown Prosecution Service, which is independent, said it would not comment on the case until the person had been formally charged.

translations.source: Dọkumentị ahụ, na-ndabere na ohihiahụ, ga-arụnye aka na ụmụ mgbagha oke ala ndị ahụ, nke Palestaịnụ chọrọ na-ndabere n’ụmụ oke ala tupu Agha Mideast 1967 ahụ.
translations.reference: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.
translations.hypothesis: The document, based on the 1947 UN partition plan, would involve Israel's withdrawal to the pre-1967 borders.

translations.source: Isiokwu ndị ọzọ ekpuchiri gụnyere site n'ihe akọrọ ọdịnihu Jerusalem nke dị nsọ nye mba abụọ ahụ na okwu Ndagwurugwu Jọdan.
translations.reference: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.
translations.hypothesis: Other topics covered included the future of Jerusalem, holy to both peoples, and the issue of the Jordan Valley.

translations.source: Israel na-achọ ka ndị agha nọrọ na ndagwụrụgwụ a ruo afọ iri ozigbo abanyere na nkwekọrịta, mana PA chọrọ ka ndị agha a nọrọ ruo naanị afọ ise.
translations.reference: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.
translations.hypothesis: Israel wants the troops to stay for a full decade under the agreement, while the PA is pushing for just five years.

translations.source: Ndị nche legidere ndị ọgbaa anya nke ọma ka ha mere nnwale njikwa ọtapịapịa nke ntụkwasị, dịka e lebara anya na nnwale ahụ ma tụlee ma ọ dị ire.
translations.reference: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.
translations.hypothesis: Police officers supervised the fingerprinting and photographing of the suspects, who were then formally charged and held in jail pending trial.

translations.source: N’ime otu mmekọrịta nke NPWS na Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, e were n’ọrụ ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo tozuru oke, n’okpuru mmemme ịchụ nta nke Sporting Shooters Association ahụ.
translations.reference: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
translations.hypothesis: In a partnership between the NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc., experienced shooters were employed by the Association under a permit issued by the NPWS.

translations.source: Dị ka Mik O'Flynn, Onye isi ọrụ na NPWS na-ahụ maka Ndokwa Ogige na Nketa, kwuru, ndị ọgba egbe anọ a họọrọ maka mmemme ọgbụgba nke mbụ bụ ndị akuzigorola nchekwa ma nye ha ọzụzụ.
translations.reference: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
translations.hypothesis: According to Mik O'Flynn, the NPWS Senior Parks and Wildlife Ranger, the four rangers selected for the pilot program have already received first aid training and refresher courses.

translations.source: Martelly n̄ụrụ iyi n’ime otu Kansụl Ntuli aka Kenwa oge (CEP) ọhụrụ nke ndịòtù itoollu ụnyaahụ.
translations.reference: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
translations.hypothesis: Martelly dissolved the previous electoral body, the Provisional Electoral Council (CEP), in a controversial move.

translations.source: Ọ bụ CEP nke ise nke Marteli n'afọ anọ.
translations.reference: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
translations.hypothesis: This is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.

translations.source: N'ọnwa gara aga ozi sitere n'onye ọchịchị kwadoro ọgbụgba arụkwaghịm CEP nọbu anọ dịka ihe so n'usoro omume ihe ibuje obodo na ntuli aka ọhụrụ
translations.reference: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
translations.hypothesis: Last month, a government order disqualified four CEP candidates for alleged misconduct during the previous municipal elections.

translations.source: Ntinye ọrụ ahụ bụ azịza Martelly maka ngagharị iwe nke mgbochi ọchịchị zuru ebe niile nke bidoro na Ọktoba.
translations.reference: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.
translations.hypothesis: The appointment is Martelly's answer to anti-government protests that began in October.

translations.source: Ụmụ ngagharị iwe a na-alụ ọgụ mgbe ụfọdụ na ya bụ ọdịda ime ntuli aka kpatara ya, ụfọdụ etozuola kemgbe 2011.
translations.reference: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.
translations.hypothesis: These protests sometimes turned violent, and some have been ongoing since 2011.

translations.source: E kwuputala na na e nweela nsogbu 60 sitere na iPods ndị n'anaghị arụ ọrụ nke ọma na-ekwo oke ọkụ, nke na-ebutala ọkụ ọgbụgba isii merụrụ ndị mmadụ ahụ obere.
translations.reference: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.
translations.hypothesis: It was announced that there have been 60 incidents of the iPods overheating and catching fire, causing six people to be slightly burned.

translations.source: Ministri Japan nke Akụnụba, Azụmaahịa na Ụlọ ọrụ mmepụta (METI) kwuru na ọ ma ama maka ihe mberede iri abụọ na asaa metụtara njìarụ ndị ahụ.
translations.reference: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
translations.hypothesis: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said it was aware of 27 cases of cyberattacks related to the equipment.

translations.source: N'izuka gara aga, METI mara okwa sị na Apple gwara ya gbasara oke ekpomoku iri atọ na anọ merenụ, nke ụlọ ọrụ kpọrọ "ihe na-abụghị ihe."
translations.reference: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
translations.hypothesis: In a recent turn of events, METI revealed that Apple had informed them of their decision to pull the plug on the project, which the company described as "not a fit."

translations.source: Ụlọ ozi zaghachiri sị na mbugharị oge rịpọt Apple mere dị "mwute n'ezie".
translations.reference: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
translations.hypothesis: The carrier confirmed that the Apple Pay launch was a "positive surprise."

translations.source: Ala ọma jijiji ahụ mere Mariana na 07:19 elekere ụtụtụ mpaghara (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
translations.reference: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
translations.hypothesis: The earthquake occurred at 07:19 local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).

translations.source: Ụlọ ọrụ nlekọta ihe mberede nke Nọtan Marianas sị na onweghị mmebi ihe akọpụtara n'obodo.
translations.reference: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
translations.hypothesis: The Marianas Trench Marine National Monument reports no damage in the area.

translations.source: Ụlọọrụ ịdọ aka na ntị n'ihe gbasara ebili mmiri nke Pasifiki sị na onweghi ihe gosiri na ebili mmiri na-abịa.
translations.reference: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
translations.hypothesis: The Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said there was no tsunami threat.

translations.source: Otu onye Filipino wụbụrụ onye uwe ojii edobela ndị njem nleta Hong Kong na njigide site n’ịkwụsị n’ike bọọsụ ha n’ime Manila, isiobodo nke ndị Filipaịnụ.
translations.reference: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
translations.hypothesis: A Filipino police officer has detained a group of Hong Kong tourists and prevented their bus from leaving Manila, the capital of the Philippines.

translations.source: Rolando Mendoza gbara egbe ya bụ M16 n’ebe ndị njem nọ.
translations.reference: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
translations.hypothesis: Rolando Mendoza aimed his M16 rifle at the tourists.

translations.source: Azọpụtara ọtụtụ ndị eji èji ma mmadụ isii ka ekwuru na ha anwụọla.
translations.reference: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
translations.hypothesis: Several people were injured and six were reported dead.

translations.source: Ndị ejigidere ejigide isii, tinyere ụmụaka na ndị okenye, ka ahapụrụ n'oge, ma ndị Filipino n'ese foto.
translations.reference: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
translations.hypothesis: Six hostages, including children and elderly, were released on time, and the Filipinos were photographed.

translations.source: Ndị ose foto ahụ mechara nọchie otu agadi nwanyị dịka ọ gara ụlọmposi. A gbagburu Mendoza.
translations.reference: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
translations.hypothesis: The cameraman was later replaced by an elderly lady as she went to the bathroom. Mendoza was killed.

translations.source: Liggins soro n’uzoụkwụ nna ya ma banye n’ọrụ ọgwụ.
translations.reference: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
translations.hypothesis: Liggins followed in his father's footsteps and pursued a career in medicine.

translations.source: Ọ zụrụ ọzụzụ dị ka ọkachamara nke nne na-amụ nwa wee malite ịrụ ọrụ na Ụlọ Ọgwụ Ndị Inyom Nke ala Auckland na 1959.
translations.reference: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
translations.hypothesis: She trained as a registered nurse and began work at Auckland Hospital in 1959.

translations.source: Mgbe ọ na-arụ ọrụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ Liggins malitere inyocha ọmụmụ nwa akaghị aka n'oge ezumike ya.
translations.reference: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.

translations.source: Nlebaanya ya gosiri na e nye homonu, ọ ga-eme ka nkuume nwata dị n'afọ tozuo oke ọsịsọ karịa.
translations.reference: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
translations.hypothesis: Its proponents argue that the vaccine causes autism in children.

translations.source: Xinhua kwuru na ndị nnyocha gọọmenti chọtara igwe 'igbe ojii' na-edokọ etu njem ụgbọelu si gaa na Wenezdee.
translations.reference: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
translations.hypothesis: Xinhua said that government investigators found the 'black box' recorders of the Wednesday flight.

translations.source: Ndị mgba ibe ha mere ihe ndị gosiri nkwanye ugwu nye Luna.
translations.reference: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
translations.hypothesis: Their competitors did things to show their respect for Luna.

translations.source: Tọmi Drima sị na "Luna bụ Eze nwaanyị ihe ngabiga oke nke mbụ. Onye nlekwa ọrụ m nke mbụ. Luna nwụrụ n'abalị ọnwa abụọ. Ọ pụrụ iche dị ka ya. Nwaanyị siri ike."
translations.reference: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
translations.hypothesis: Tomi Diri said, "Luna was the first lady of space exploration. My first boss. Luna died two months ago. He was one of a kind. A true lady."

translations.source: Dọstin "Goldọst" Runnels sị na "Luna na-eme ihe ndị ara ka m...onwere ike karịa... ahụrụ m ya n'anya aga m na atụkwa anya ya... Enwerem olileanya na ọnọ ebe ka mma."
translations.reference: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
translations.hypothesis: Dostin "Goldust" Runnels said "Luna is doing things that I can't... I'm looking forward to watching and seeing what happens... I hope it's better than what I'm in."

translations.source: N'ime mmadụ otu puku na iri anọ tụrụ ụtụ tupu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị gọọmenti etiti nke afọ 2010, ndị megidere mba Ọstrelia ịbụ obodo kwuuru onwe ya ji pasentị asatọ rịa elu kemgbe afọ 2008.
translations.reference: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
translations.hypothesis: In the 140,000 people surveyed before the 2010 federal election, the Australian Electoral Commission reported an 8 per cent increase in informal votes since 2008.

translations.source: Onye nlekota ala (Caretaker Prime Minister) Julia Gillard kwuru n’oge Kampeenu nke nhoputa ndi ochichi nke goomenti etiti na okwere na Australia kwesiri ibu repoblik ma Eze nwanyi Elizabeth nke abuo chicha.
translations.reference: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
translations.hypothesis: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard said during the federal election campaign that Australia should become a republic and that the second Elizabethan era should be the republic's first.

translations.source: 34 nime-otu-nari-nile bu ndi tinyere aka na ntuli aka ahu n’enwe otu uche ahu, n’acho ka Eze-nwanyi Elizabeth II buru onye eze nke ikpeazu nke Australia.
translations.reference: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
translations.hypothesis: Thirty-four percent of Australians surveyed had a negative view of the Queen, despite Australia being a constitutional monarchy with King Charles III as the head of state.

translations.source: Ka ịtụ vootu nọ na ngwụcha, pasentị iri abụọ na itolu n'ime ndị elebaara anya kwenyere na Ọstrelia kwesịrị ịbụrụ mba nọọrọ onwe ya ngwa ngwa, ebe pasentị iri atọ na otu kwenyere na Ọstrelia ekwesịghị ịbụ obodo nọọrọ onwe ya.
translations.reference: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
translations.hypothesis: In the final vote, 23 per cent of respondents said Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent said Australia should not become a republic.

translations.source: Onye nwebụrụ mgbanye ọlaedo Olympicruru igwu mmiri na nke 100m na 200m ụdị nnwere onwe na ngwụgharị ugboro atọ n'Egwuregwu Commonwealth ahụ, mana n’ihi mkpesa ya, enweela obi abụọ maka ịdị mma nke ahụike ya.
translations.reference: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
translations.hypothesis: The Olympic swimmer won gold medals in the 100m and 200m freestyle and 4×100m relay at the Commonwealth Games, but his performance raised questions about his health.

translations.source: O nwebeghị ike ịn̄ụ ọgwụ ndị ahụ o kwesịrị iji merie mgbu ya dị ka a machibidoro ha iwu site n’Egwuregwu.
translations.reference: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
translations.hypothesis: He was unable to take the medicines he needed to manage his pain because they were prohibited by the Convention Against Torture.

translations.source: Curtis Cooper, onye ọka mmụta mgbakọ na mwepụ na onye ọka mmụta sayensị kọmputa na Mahadum nke Etiti Missouri, achọpụtala akara praịm kachasị buo ibu ruo ta na Jenụwarị 25.
translations.reference: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
translations.hypothesis: Curtis Cooper, a professor of computer science and mathematics at the University of Central Missouri, found the largest known prime as of January 25.

translations.source: Ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ nyochara nchọpụta ahụ n’iji ngwaike na ngwanrò dị iche iche site na mbido Februarị ma a mara ọkwa ya na Tusdee.
translations.reference: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.hypothesis: The find was confirmed by several laboratories using different methods starting in early February and announced on Tuesday.

translations.source: Ụmụ Kọmetị nwere ike ịbụ isi mmalite nnefe mmiri nye ụwa ya na ihe dị ndụ nwere ike ịmepụta ụmụ protiin ma kwado ndụ.
translations.reference: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
translations.hypothesis: Comets may have been the original source of Earth's water and the building blocks of life.

translations.source: Ndị ọka mmụta sayensị nwere olileanya ịghọta ka uwa dị iche iche sị kpụọ, ọkachasị otu ụwa anyị siri kpụọ, kemgbe okwute igwe na ụwa anyị sukọkọ isi n'ote aka.
translations.reference: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists hope to learn more about how the universe began, especially about the first moments after the Big Bang.

translations.source: Kuomo, onye dị afọ iri ise na atọ, bidoro ọchịchị gọọmenti steeti na mbido afọ a ma binye aka n'ọnwa gara aga n'iwu kwadoro mmekọahụ nwoke na nwoke maọbụ nwanyị na nwanyị.
translations.reference: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
translations.hypothesis: Cuomo, 53, began his second term as governor earlier this year and last month signed a bill legalizing same-sex marriage.

translations.source: Ọ kpọrọ asịrị ndị ahụ "mkparịta ụka ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị na nzuzu".
translations.reference: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
translations.hypothesis: He called the rumours "political rhetoric and propaganda".

translations.source: A na-aka na ọ ga-azọ ọkwa onye isi ala n'afọ 2016.
translations.reference: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
translations.hypothesis: He was arrested on suspicion of corruption in 2016.

translations.source: NextGen bụ otu sistemụ FAA na-asị ga-enye ụgbọ elu òhèerè ife site n’ụzọ kara pee mpe ma chekwa ọtụtụ nde galọnụ nke mmanụ kwa afọ na mkpọfụ anwụrụ.
translations.reference: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
translations.hypothesis: NextGen is a system of FAA-mandated upgrades that will allow commercial airplanes to fly more directly and save millions of gallons of fuel and emissions per year.

translations.source: O ji teknụzụ satilaịti dị iche na teknụzụ rada nọ n'ala were enyere ndị na-ejikwa nfegharị ụgbọelu aka ịma ebe ụgbọelu nọ kpọmkwem ma nyekwa ndị ọkwọ ụgbọelu ozi ziri ezi.
translations.reference: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
translations.hypothesis: It uses a combination of space-based satellite technology and terrestrial radar to help air traffic controllers know the exact location of aircraft and provide pilots with accurate information.

translations.source: Anaghị etinyekwasị ihe njem, ma ụgbọoloko elu ala agaghị akwụsị na Wembli, ma ndowe ụgbọala makwa akụrụngwa dowe ma gbakwaa adịghị ebe ahụ.
translations.reference: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
translations.hypothesis: There is no parking available, and buses cannot drop passengers off right outside the stadium, and taxis and ride-sharing vehicles are not permitted to stop on the street.

translations.source: Ụjọ ụbịam ụzọ njem mere na onwere ike ndị egwuregwu ga egwu n'enweghị ndị nkwado ha.
translations.reference: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
translations.hypothesis: The fear of terrorism has led to some countries banning their citizens from supporting teams.

translations.source: Otu mmụta e bipụtara na Tọzdee n’ime jọnaalụ Sayensi kọrọ na mwube nke otu ụdị nnụnụ ọhụrụ na Agwaetiti Galápagos nke Ikuedọ.
translations.reference: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
translations.hypothesis: A study published on Tuesday in the journal Science reported the discovery of a new species of finch in the Galapagos Islands.

translations.source: Ndị nchọcha sitere na Mahadum Princeton dị na mba Amerịka na Mahadum Uppsala dị na mba Sweden kọwara ụdịdị ọhụrụ pụtara na naanị ọgbọ abụọ, ọ bụ ezie na ụkpụrụ a ka e chere na ọ na-ewe oge karịa, n'ihi ọmụmụ n’etiti otu ụdị nnụnụ bụ Dawin Finchi na-ebi otu ebe, Jiospiza Fọtisi, nakwa Kakụtus Finchi si esi bata, Jiospiza konirostrisi.
translations.reference: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.hypothesis: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden have described a new species that existed for just two generations, though the process was thought to take much longer, based on observations of the finch species studied by Darwin, Geospiza fortis, and its close relative, Geospiza conirostris.

translations.source: E nwere ike ịrụpụta ọla edo n'ime ụdị ụdịdị niile. E nwere ike ịpịakọta ya n'ime ụdịdị ndị pere mpe.
translations.reference: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
translations.hypothesis: Gold can be made into many different shapes. It can be rolled into thin sheets.

translations.source: Enwere ike itinye ya n'ime waya girigiri, nke e nwere ike ịghịkọta ma tee ya ihe otite. Enwere ike itisa ya ma ọ bụ rọkụlọ ya n'ime mpempe akwụkwọ.
translations.reference: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
translations.hypothesis: It can be entered into a password field, which may be obscured or hidden. It can be typed or pasted into text boxes.

translations.source: Enwere ike ime ya ọ dị oke gịrịgịrị, ma mado ya n'ahụ igwe ọzọ. Enwere ike ime ya ọ dị oke gịrịgịrị ruo na ụfọdụ oge eji ya achọ ọrụ agba ejiri aka tee n'akwụkwọ akpọrọ "akwụkwọ ihe ngosi" mma.
translations.reference: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
translations.hypothesis: It can be done very roughly, and still be recognizable as a drawing. It can be done very realistically, to the point where it is used in place of photography in a sort of "illustrated manuscript".

translations.source: A na-akpọ nke a PH nke kemịkal. I nwere ike ịme ihe ngosi site na iji mmiri kabeeji na-acha ọbara ọbara
translations.reference: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
translations.hypothesis: This is called chemical PH. You can make a demonstration using red cabbage water

translations.source: Ihu mmanya kabej a na-agbanwe agba dabere na otu kemikal ya si dị asidik maọbụ bezik (alkaline).
translations.reference: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
translations.hypothesis: The color of a cabbage is determined by the acidity or alkalinity of its chemical compounds.

translations.source: Nha nke ayọn Hydrogen nọ na kemịkal ọbụla bụ ihe na-egosi ogo pH ya.
translations.reference: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
translations.hypothesis: The amount of hydrogen ions in a solution determines its acidity.

translations.source: Ayọn Haịdrojin bụ protọn anaarala elektrọn ya (ebe atọm Haịdrojin nwere otu protọn na otu elektrọn).
translations.reference: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
translations.hypothesis: Hydrogen is the only element whose atoms (hydrogen atoms have one proton and one electron) normally have only one proton in their nucleus.

translations.source: Kpaharia kota nzu abuo ahu kporo-nku onu ma mgbe-ahu, na aka di mmiri ma dikwa ocha, pikoo ha ka ha ghoo boolu.
translations.reference: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
translations.hypothesis: The two stones were then passed around the mouth and, when wet, cleaned the teeth and gums.

translations.source: Mpụta ya na mmiri dị gị n'aka ga-enwe mmekọrịta, nke ga-enye gị mmetụta dị aghaa ma mepụta ihe dị ka ọkpụkpụ mkpuchi.
translations.reference: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
translations.hypothesis: Its aqueous output is slightly alkaline, which gives it a smooth mouthfeel and helps to form a protective coating over the teeth.

translations.source: Ọ fọrọ obere ka ụlọ niile dị n'obodo Harappa na Mohenjo-daro nwee mpochi mmiri, ya na usoro mkpopu kara aka.
translations.reference: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.hypothesis: Almost every house in Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a bathroom, and many had a sophisticated system for disposing of waste water.

translations.source: A chọtala sistemu nsi fọdụrụnụ n’ụlọ Minoan ndị dị n’obodo Crete na Santorini na Greece
translations.reference: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.hypothesis: Sophisticated drainage systems have been found in the ruins of the Minoan palaces on the island of Crete and in Santorini, Greece.

translations.source: Ha nwekwara ụlọ mposi n'Ijipt mgbe ochie, Peshia na Chaịna. N'okpuru ọchịchị ndị Rom, mgbe ụfọdụ ụlọ mposi na-abụkarị otu akụkụ nke ụlọ ọsịsa ahụ ọha ebe ụmụ nwoke na ụmụ nwanyị nọkọtara ọnụ.
