translations.source: Yurop bụ kọntinent dị obere na mmetụta ma nwee ọtụtụ mba nwere onwe ha. N’okpuru ọnọdụ nkịtị, ime njem gafee ọtụtụ mba ga-apụta ị ga site na ntinye akwụkwọ maka visa na njikwa paspọọtụ ọtụtụ oge.
translations.reference: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
translations.hypothesis: Europe is a relatively small continent with a high number of independent countries. Under normal circumstances, traveling across many of these countries will require you to present your passport and supporting visa documentation several times.

translations.source: Agbanyeghị, mpaghara Schengen na-arụ ọrụ dịka mba a na-akwanyere ugwu.
translations.reference: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
translations.hypothesis: However, the Schengen Area operates as a single country.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ị nọrọ n'ọgbọ a, i nwere ike igafe oke ala ma zere nnyocha paspọtụ.
translations.reference: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
translations.hypothesis: If you are in this age group, you may be able to cross the border and avoid passport checks.

translations.source: N'otu aka ahụ, site n’inwe otu visa Schengen, ị kwesịghịzi itinye akwụkwọ maka visa otu n’ime mba ndịòtù Schengen nke ọ bụla iche, ya mere chekwa oge, ego na mmepe akwụkwọ.
translations.reference: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
translations.hypothesis: At the same time, with a Schengen visa, you shouldn't have to apply for individual visas for any of the Schengen countries, thus saving time, money and paperwork.

translations.source: Onweghi nkwekọrịta zuru ụwa maka ngwa a na-akpọ ihe ochie. Ụfọdụ ụlọ ọrụ ụtụ na-akpọ ngwa ndị karịrị afọ 100 ihe ochie.
translations.reference: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
translations.hypothesis: There is no universal agreement on what constitutes an antique. Some tax authorities consider items over 100 years old to be antiques.

translations.source: Nkọwasị ahụ nwere ọdịiche kwa ọdịdị ala, ebe ókè afọ nwere ike ịdị obere karịa n'ebe ndị dị ka Ugwu Amerịka karịa n'ime Yurop.
translations.reference: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
translations.hypothesis: The definition also varies by region, with the age at which it is considered to begin being lower in some regions such as North America than in Europe.

translations.source: Enwere ike ikpo ngwaahia eji aka ruo ihe mgbe ochie, n’agbanyeghi na o di ohuru karia ngwaahia ndi nke emere maka oha.
translations.reference: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
translations.hypothesis: The manual wheelchair is probably the oldest of the mobility devices, though it is a relatively new invention compared to the history of human mobility.

translations.source: Ọzụzụ Reindeer dị mkpa nke ukwuu ọkachasị n’ime ihe banyere ndụ na omenaala ndị Sámi nakwa ahịa gbara ya okirikiri dịkwa mkpa maka ọtụtụ akaọrụ ndị ọzọ.
translations.reference: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
translations.hypothesis: The reindeer herding is a very important part of the Sami culture and history and is also important for many other livelihoods.

translations.source: Ọbụna n'ọdịnala, agbanyeghị, ọ bụghị Sámi niile bụ ndị metụtara n'ime nnukwu ogo ọzụzụ anụmanụ reendiya, mana biri site n'igbu azụ, ịchụ nta na ihe yiri ya, na-enwe reendiya n'ọtụtụ oge dị ka ụmụ anụmanụ akpọbatara.
translations.reference: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
translations.hypothesis: Even traditionally, not all Sami are involved in reindeer herding, but live by fishing, hunting and similar activities, with reindeer herding as a subsidiary activity.

translations.source: Taa ọtụtụ Sámi na-arụ ọrụ n’ụmụ ahịa nke ugbu a. Njem nleta bụ mkpata egọ dị mkpa na Sápmi, mpaghara Sámi ahụ.
translations.reference: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
translations.hypothesis: Today most Sámi work in the modern sector. Tourism is an important economic factor in Sápmi, the Sámi homeland.

translations.source: Agbanyeghị na ndị abụghị ndị Roma na-ekwu ya n'etiti ha, a na-ahụta aha a bụ "Gypsy" dị ka aha ọjọọ maka na ọ gbasara ụfọdụ ụzọ ọjọọ ndị ọzọ si ahụta ndị Roma, nke abụghị eziokwu.
translations.reference: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
translations.hypothesis: Although the word is used among non-Roma to refer to Roma, the term "Gypsy" is considered pejorative by many Roma because of its association with other negative stereotypes about Roma people, which are untrue.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na mba ahụ ị ga-aga ileta bụrụ nke nọ n'okpuru otu ndụmọdụ njem, mkpuchi ahụike njem gị ma ọ bụ mkpuchi nkagbu njem gị bụ nke o nwere ike imetụta.
translations.reference: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
translations.hypothesis: If your destination country is under a health travel advisory, your travel health insurance or travel medical evacuation insurance may be affected.

translations.source: Ị nwere ike ịjụta ndụmọdụ nke ndị ọchịchị karịa nke gị, mana ndụmọdụ ha bụ ndị e mebere maka ndị amaala ha.
translations.reference: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
translations.hypothesis: You can ask your local government for advice, but their advice is biased towards their own citizens.

translations.source: Iji mee atụ, ndị Amerịka nọ na Mịdụl Ist nwere ike igabiga ihe dị iche n'ihe ndị Yurop maọbụ Arab ga-agabiga.
translations.reference: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
translations.hypothesis: For example, Americans in the Middle East may have more in common with Europeans than with Arabs.

translations.source: Ndị ndụmọdụ gasị bụ naanị obere nchịkọta nke ọnọdụ ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị n’otu obodo.
translations.reference: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
translations.hypothesis: The advisors are only a small part of the political landscape in any country.

translations.source: Uche ndị e gosipụtara na-esekarị n'elu, n'izugbe na ntọghasị dị ukwuu ma a tụnyere ya ozi ndị a kọwara nke ọma dị ebe ọzọ.
translations.reference: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
translations.hypothesis: The views expressed above are generally more positive, global and constructive in tone as compared to the comments expressed elsewhere.

translations.source: Ajọ ihu igwe bụ aha izugbe a na-akpọ ihe ọbụla gbasara ihu igwe nke nwere ike imebi ihe, ghasaa mmekọrịta, maọbụ gbuo mmadụ.
translations.reference: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
translations.hypothesis: A meteorological hazard is a dangerous phenomenon that occurs in the atmosphere and can cause damage, injury, or death.

translations.source: Ihu igwe dị oke njọ nwere ike ime n'ebe ọbụla n'ụwa, ma o nwere ụdị dị iche iche, nke nwere ike idabere na ọdịdịala, ọdịdịebe na ọnọdụ keikuku.
translations.reference: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
translations.hypothesis: Severe weather can strike anywhere in the world, and it takes many forms, some of which are dependent on the local geography, climate and position relative to large bodies of water.

translations.source: Ụmụ oke ifufe, mkpụrụ mmiri, oke mmiri ozuzo, na ọkụọhịa bụ ụmụ ụdị na mmetụta nke ihu igwe dị oke njọ, dị ka ụmụ egbe eluigwe mmiri ozuzo, ajọọ̀ oke ifufe, ajọọ̀ ifufe mmiri, na ajọọ̀ oke mmiri ozuzo.
translations.reference: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
translations.hypothesis: Tropical cyclones, also known as typhoons or hurricanes, are among the most destructive weather phenomena.

translations.source: Ihe ihu igwe siri ike na-eme na mpaghara na n'oge ụfọdụ gụnyere blizadị, oke ikuku na ọdịda ibubeoyi, oke ikuku na ọdịda aịzị, na oke ifufe na-ebu aja.
translations.reference: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
translations.hypothesis: Extreme weather events are occurring with increasing frequency and intensity around the world and include tropical cyclones, hurricanes and typhoons, heatwaves and droughts, and extreme precipitation and flooding.

translations.source: Ana adusi ndi njem odu ike ha mara gbasara ihe ndaba nke ekpem-oku maobu di oke ukwuu nke na emetuta ogbe ha dika onwere ike imetuta atumatu ime-njem obula.
translations.reference: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
translations.hypothesis: Travellers should be aware of the current security situation and its possible effect on their travel plans.

translations.source: Onye ọbụla na-achọ ịga mba ọbụla bụ ọgbọ agha kwesịrị ka e kuziere ya etu e si eme ya.
translations.reference: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
translations.hypothesis: Anyone wishing to go to any foreign country should be taught how to do so.

translations.source: Ọchịchọ n'ịntanetị maka 'Ọmụmụ gburugburu keiro' nwere ike iweta adreesị otu ụlọọrụ imeobodo.
translations.reference: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
translations.hypothesis: A web search for "chiropractor near me" can easily bring up addresses of local practitioners.

translations.source: Otu ihe ọmụmụ ga-akọwa nke ọma ihe niile a kọwara ebe a tinyekwa ahụmihe bara uru.
translations.reference: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
translations.hypothesis: A case study will then illustrate all the above mentioned aspects in a practical way.

translations.source: Ihe ọmụmụ na-abụkarị site na ụbọchị abuo ruo ụbọchị ise ma ọ ga-emetụta mmepụta omume, ọtụtụ mgbata ọsọ enyemaka mbụ na ọzụzụ maka ngwaagha n'oge ụfọdụ .
translations.reference: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
translations.hypothesis: Courses typically last anywhere between two and five days and may involve role-playing, group activities, case studies and, in some cases, military-style training.

translations.source: Ụmụ akwụkwọ na magaziini ndị na-akọ maka nlanarị nke ọzara juru eju, mana ụmụ mbipụta na-akọ maka ebe a na-alụ agha dị obere.
translations.reference: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
translations.hypothesis: There are many books and articles about the history of the occupation, but fewer publications about the settlements themselves.

translations.source: Ndị njem ụgbọ mmiri na-eme atụmatụ ịwa ahụ ntụgharị mmekọahụ na mba ofesi ga-ejiriri n'aka na ha ji ụmụ akwụkwọ ziri ezi maka njem nlaghachi.
translations.reference: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
translations.hypothesis: Passengers on international flights should use the correct travel documents for their journey home.

translations.source: Ịdị njikere ndị ọchịchị inye akwụkwọ ikike ngafe ndị a na-edepụtaghị jenda ha (X) maọbụ dọkụmentị emelitere ka ọ daba n’aha a chọrọ ma jenda adị iche.
translations.reference: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
translations.hypothesis: The readiness of governments to grant these exceptions is indicated by whether they have signed (X) or updated their documents to reflect the new name and logo.

translations.source: Njikere nke ndị ọchịchị mba ndị ọzọ ịsọpụrụ akwụkwọ ndị a dị nnọọ ka ihe na-agbanwe agbanwe.
translations.reference: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
translations.hypothesis: The willingness of foreign governments to extradite their citizens is highly variable.

translations.source: Ọchịchọ na ebe nyocha nchedo abụrụkwala oke nsogbu mbanye n’ike n’ime oge Septemba 11, 2001 gachara.
translations.reference: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
translations.hypothesis: The need for more secure screening procedures has increased since the September 11, 2001 attacks.

translations.source: Ndi transgender n’emebeghi oparashon atubekwana anya na ha gafecha ihe nyocha na ha ka ga ano na nzuzo ma ugwu ha adikwachim.
translations.reference: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
translations.hypothesis: Transgender people who do not have access to safe and affordable surgery options may seek out clandestine providers and face serious health risks.

translations.source: Oke ọchịchị mmiri bụ mmiri na-asọlata asọlata site n'ebili mmiri tikapụrụ n'ọnụ, na-emekarị n'okwute ala mmiri maọbụ ihe yiri ya.
translations.reference: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
translations.hypothesis: Tidal bores are a phenomenon in which a wave moves up a river against the current, often occurring in estuaries or similar landforms.

translations.source: N'ihi tọpọlọjì nke okpuru mmiri ahụ, mmiri na-abanyeghachi dị ike n'akụkụ ole na ole miri emi, ma ike ọwụwụ mmiri ngwa ngwa ruo na mmiri dị omimi nwere ike ịmepụta n'ebe ahụ.
translations.reference: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the bathymetry, the water piles up on the continental shelf, and the kinetic energy of the water is converted into a rise in water level.

translations.source: Imirikiti ọnwụ na-eme n'ihi ike ọgwụgwụ n'ịgbalị igwughachi azụ megide kọrenti mmiri, nke nwere ike ọ gaghị ekwe omume.
translations.reference: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
translations.hypothesis: Most deaths are due to trauma sustained while trying to escape the flood waters, which is often impossible.

translations.source: Ozugbo ị na-esi n'ọwụwụ mmiri ahụ pụta, igwughachi azụ na-aka ara ahụ karịa na nkịtị.
translations.reference: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
translations.hypothesis: Once you are out of the water, the fish's rehydration causes it to swell up.

translations.source: Gbalịa tụọ atụmatụ ọzọ maka ebe ejidebeghi gị, maọbụ, dabere na nka gị yana ma achọpụtala gị, ị nwere ike ịchere maka nnapụta.
translations.reference: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
translations.hypothesis: Try to come up with a plan to escape, or, depending on your skills and if you are discovered, you may just have to wait it out.

translations.source: Mmenyeụjọ mbanyegharị abia na nkpirikpi karia mmenyeụjọ omenala (enwere agba họnịịmuunu dịtụ ntakịrị), dịruru ogologo, ma nwee ike ịka njọ.
translations.reference: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
translations.hypothesis: Migraine attacks are generally more disabling than tension-headaches (although they are less common), last longer, and are more likely to be aggravated by routine physical activity.

translations.source: Ndị njem ndị nwere oge dị mfe ịnọgharị n’omenala ọhụrụ mgbe ụfọdụ na-enwe oge siri ike ịnọgharịkwa n’omenala keobodo ha.
translations.reference: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
translations.hypothesis: Travellers with a limited time to travel often find it easy to adapt to the new culture while people in their home culture find it difficult to adapt to new cultures.

translations.source: Mgbe a na-alaghachite n’ụlọ mgbe e bichara n’obodo oyibo, ị nweela mmara ahụ nye omenala ọhụrụ ahụ ma tufuokwa ụfọdụ agwa gị si n’omenala nke ụlọ gị.
translations.reference: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
translations.hypothesis: When you go back home after living in a foreign country, you bring with you a new awareness of your own culture and some new values from the culture in which you lived.

translations.source: Mgbe ị gara na mba ofesi na mbụ, ndị mmadụ nwere ike ha nwere ndidi na nghọta, na-amara na ndị njem nọ n'ime mba ọhụrụ chọrọ imegharị ahụ nnọshị̀.
translations.reference: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
translations.hypothesis: When you go to a foreign country for the first time, people are more likely to be patient and understanding, knowing that foreigners are bound to make cultural mistakes.

translations.source: Ikekwe ndị mmadụ agaghị atụ anya na ndidi na nnagide bụ ihe ndị njem na-alaghachi ụlọ aghaghị inwe.
translations.reference: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
translations.hypothesis: Perhaps people do not expect that travelers need to be polite and respectful.

translations.source: Ihe ngosi uda na oku piramidi bu ihe kachasi akpalite mmuo emere maka umuaka n’ebe a.
translations.reference: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid and Sphinx are the most impressive sights for children in this area.

translations.source: Ị nwere ike ịhụ piramidi n'ime itiri ma ị nwere ike ịhụ ha n'ịgbachi nkịtị tupu ihe ngosi ahụ ebido.
translations.reference: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
translations.hypothesis: You can see the pyramids from the road and you can see them in the distance before you even arrive at the site.

translations.source: Mgbe niile ị na-anụkarị ụda ndị njem nleta na ndị na-ere ahịa. Akụkọ gbasara ụda na ọkụ dị nnọọ ka otu akwụkwọ akụkọ ifo.
translations.reference: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
translations.hypothesis: You can often hear the tour guides and the vendors shouting. The stories about sounds and light are very much like a tall tale.

translations.source: Edobere Sphinx ka ihe mgbakwasa na onye na ako akuko toro ogologo
translations.reference: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
translations.hypothesis: Sphinx was designed as a counterweight to the long-range, high-flying bombers of the era.

translations.source: A na-egosipụta ihe ngosi ndị ahụ na piramidi ndị ahụ ma mere ka piramidi ndị ahụ dị iche iche na-enwukepụ.
translations.reference: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
translations.hypothesis: The paintings are displayed in the pyramids and give a good idea of the original decoration of the pyramids.

translations.source: Sawụt Shetland Aịlands, nke a chọpụtara na 1819, bụ ebe ọtụtụ mba na-azọ; Agwaetiti nọ na ya karịrị ndị nọ ebe ọzọ, ebe agụtara iri na isii nọ n'ọrụ n'afọ 2020.
translations.reference: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
translations.hypothesis: The Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are a group of islands that are part of the United Kingdom; the islands had 63 lighthouses in 2020.

translations.source: Archipelago ahụ tọgbọọrọ na Km 120 na mpaghara ugwu nke obodo akụkụ mmiri ahụ. Nke kachasị buo ibu bụ Agwaetiti Eze George nwere ebe obibi nke Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.reference: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.hypothesis: The archipelago is located 120 km north of the mainland. The largest is King George Island with the Villa Las Estrellas settlement.

translations.source: Ndị ọzọ gụnyere Agwaetiti Livingston, na Nghọgbu ebe caldera mmiri tojuru nke ugwu mgbawa ka dị ire na-enye otu ebe obibi dị ịtụnanya.
translations.reference: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
translations.hypothesis: Others include the Livingston Island and the caldera Deception Island, a sunken volcanic crater which offers a unique landscape.

translations.source: Ala Ellsworth bụ mpaghara ndịna nke Penịnsụla, Oke osimiri Bellingshausen gbara ya gburugburu.
translations.reference: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
translations.hypothesis: The Ellsworth Land is a region of the Antarctic Peninsula, which is surrounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.

translations.source: Ugwu ndị Peninsụla ahụ nọ ebe a jikọtara ọnụ ịghọ ugwu dị larịị ahụ, mgbe ahụ jikọgharịa ịghọ km 360 eriri igwe nke Ugwu ndị Ellsworth ahụ, egbubiri abụọ site n’aka Glesịa Minnesota ahụ.
translations.reference: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
translations.hypothesis: The Peninsula Mountains are a series of connected, relatively low mountains, that form a 360 km long chain across the Ellsworth Mountains, split in two by the Minnesota Glacier.

translations.source: Akụkụ ebe ugwu ma ọ bụ Renji Sentinel nwere ugwu ndị kachasị elu nke Antaatika, Vinson Massif ahụ, na-eru ọnụ elu na 4892 m Ugwu Vinson.
translations.reference: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.hypothesis: The northernmost part of the continent, or the Antarctic Peninsula, has the highest mountains of the continent, the Vinson Massif, with Mount Vinson reaching 4,892 m (16,050 ft).

translations.source: N'ebe ndị zopuru ezopu, n'enweghị netwọk ekwentị, ikekwe ekwentị satịlaịt ga-abụ naanị nzọpụta i nwere.
translations.reference: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
translations.hypothesis: In remote areas without cell service, a satellite phone may be your only option.

translations.source: Otu ekwentị satịlaịtị abụghị nnọchite anya n’izugbe nke ekwentị kengagharị, dị ka ị kwesịrị ịnọ n’ezi ya na inwe ụzọ warawara ịhụ satịlaịtị iji ya kpọọ oku ekwentị.
translations.reference: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
translations.hypothesis: A satellite phone is not a replacement for a normal cell phone, as you need a clear view of the sky to make calls with a satellite phone.

translations.source: Ọrụ ahụ bụ nke mbupu na-ejikarị, gụnyere nka obi ụtọ, ya na ụmụ njem nchọpụta ndị nwere mkpa datà ebe dịanya na olu.
translations.reference: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
translations.hypothesis: The job is a combination of delivery services, including fun runs and treasure hunts, and data collection missions that involve visiting specific locations and recording audio.

translations.source: Onye ọrụ ekwentị ebeụlọ gị kwesịrị inwe ike inyekwu ozi gbasara ị na-ejikọta n'ọrụ a.
translations.reference: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
translations.hypothesis: Your mobile service provider should be able to give you more information about connecting to this service.

translations.source: Otu nhọrọ kara ewu ewu n'ụzọ na-amụbanye maka ndị na-atụ arọ ịnara otu ohere-afọ bụ ime njem ma mụta.
translations.reference: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
translations.hypothesis: A more adventurous and increasingly popular option for a year out is to travel and learn.

translations.source: Ọ bụ ndị si ụlọ akwụkwọ pụta na-emekarị nke a, maka ọ na-ekwe ka ha jiri otu afọ zuo ike tupu ha abanye mahadum, ma ghara imebi mmụta ha.
translations.reference: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
translations.hypothesis: This is usually done by students who wish to take a year or more off before starting university, and not ruin their education.

translations.source: Ọtụtụ oge, ịdebanye aha n'ọmụmụ ohere-afọ na mba ofesi nwere ike imelite n'ezie ohere i nwere isonye n'agụmakwụkwọ dị elu n'obodo ebe i si.
translations.reference: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
translations.hypothesis: Often, studying abroad can actually help you get into a better school in your home country.

translations.source: A ga-enwekarị ụgwọ akwụkwọ iji debanye aha n’ime ụmụ emume mmụta ndị a.
translations.reference: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
translations.hypothesis: There are often fees associated with signing up for these learning events.

translations.source: Finlandị bụ ebe dị oke mma maka inya ụgbọ mmiri. “Ala nke otu puku ọdọ mmiri” ahụ nwekwara ọtụtụ puku agwaetiti, n’ime ọdọ mmiri ndị ahụ ma n’akụkụ mmiri nke òtù agwaetiti.
translations.reference: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
translations.hypothesis: Finland is a great place for boating holidays. The "Land of a Thousand Lakes" also has thousands of islands, in the lakes and along the sea.

translations.source: Na otu agwaetiti n’umu ọdọ mmiri ị gaghị achọriri ụgbọ mmiri.
translations.reference: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
translations.hypothesis: On an island in the middle of the ocean you don't really need a car.

translations.source: Agbanyeghị n'òtù agwaetiti akụkụ mmiri ahụ na ụmụ ọdọ mmiri kachasị ibu bụ ndị nke buru ibu n'ezie maka yaach ọ bụla, ụgbọ mmiri ndị kara obere ma ọ bụ ọbụna otu kayak na-enye ahụmihe dị iche.
translations.reference: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
translations.hypothesis: While the larger islands and harbors are very developed for tourism, smaller islands and even just a kayak can provide a more solitary experience.

translations.source: Akwọm ụgbọmmiri bụ ihe mmemme nchereoge na mba Finlandị, nke bụ otu ụgbọmmiri ibu mmadụ asaa maọbụ asatọ.
translations.reference: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
translations.hypothesis: A Finnish archipelago boat is a type of motorboat used in the Finnish archipelago, typically able to carry seven to eight people.

translations.source: Norway, Sweden na New Zealand emegokwa ya, mana ewezụga ha, ihe a bụ ihe mmeta pụrụ iche (dịka ọmụmaatụ na Netherlands fịgọ a bụ otu nye iri anọ).
translations.reference: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
translations.hypothesis: Norway, Sweden and New Zealand also have them, but outside these, they are more of a speciality item (in the Netherlands, for example, they are only available in about 40 stores).

translations.source: Ọtụtụ n'ime Njem Ụgbọmmiri Baltik pụrụiche na-enye njirimara nke ọnụnọ agbatịrị n'ime St. Pitasbọọg Rọshịa.
translations.reference: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the Baltic Sea cruises offer a taste of the Russian presence in St. Petersburg.

translations.source: Nke a pụtara na i nwere ike ịwere ụfọdụ ụbọchị gaa leta obodo ochie a, ma na-echighata n'ụgbọ mmiri ịrahụ ụra abalị.
translations.reference: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
translations.hypothesis: This means that you can take a few days to explore the ancient city, and sleep on a boat.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ị nọ n'ụgbọmmiri eme njem nlereanya nke naanị elu ala ị gaghị enweta visa dị iche maka ya (bidori na 2009).
translations.reference: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
translations.hypothesis: If you are on a round the world flight with only one stopover you do not need a separate visa for that stopover (rule change in 2009).

translations.source: Ụfọdụ njem ụgbọ mmiri na-enye njirimara Beelịn, Jamani n'ime ụmụ broshuọ ahụ. Dị ka ị nwere ike ịhụ site na maapụ ahụ n'elu Beelịn anọghị oke osimiri ahụ nso ma ọlị ma otu nleta n'obodo ahụ bụ nke agụnyeghị n'ọnụahịa nke njem ụgbọ mmiri ahụ.
translations.reference: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
translations.hypothesis: Some of the boat trips offer a Berlin-Brandenburg ticket, which is valid on all public transport in the region. As you can see from the map above, Berlin is not very close to the sea and a day trip to the coast is not possible within a normal day trip.

translations.source: Njem ụgbọ elu nwere ike bụ ihe egwu ny onye ọbụla agbanyeghị afọ ole ha dị maobụ ebe ha si, ọkachasị ma ọ bụrụ na ha efebeghị mbụ maọbụ na ha enwego ihe ọghọm mbụ.
translations.reference: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
translations.hypothesis: Flying in an airplane can be a nerve-wracking experience for just about anyone regardless of age or background, especially if they've never done it before or have a fear of heights.

translations.source: Ọ bụghị ihe ihere: ọ dịghị iche dị n'etiti ya na mmadụ inwe egwu gbasara ihe nwere ike ime na ndụ ya nakwa enweghi mmasị n'ihe ndị ọzọ nke ọtụtụ mmadụ nwere.
translations.reference: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
translations.hypothesis: It is not uncommon: there is hardly a difference between being afraid of something and not being interested in something that most people are interested in.

translations.source: Maka ụfọdụ, nghọta ihe gbasara otu ụgbọ elu si arụ ọrụ na ihe na-eme n'ime otu njem ụgbọelu nwere ike inye aka ịgabiga ụjọ nke dabere na ihe amaghị ma ọ bụ anọghị na njikwa.
translations.reference: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
translations.hypothesis: For some, a general understanding of how airplanes work and what is involved in a typical flight can help to alleviate concerns based on the unknown or on a lack of control.

translations.source: A na-akwụ ndị ụlọ ọrụ na-ebugharị ngwa ụgwọ nke ọma maka ibuga ihe ngwa ngwa. Kwa ugboro, oge dị ezigbo mkpa n'ebe akwụkwọ azụmahịa nọ, ngwa ahịa maọbụ akụkụ nnochite maka nrụzi igwe ọbụla ngwa ngwa.
translations.reference: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
translations.hypothesis: The logistics companies deliver the packages and the documents. Sometimes, the documents are needed for business, for marketing or for any other reason.

translations.source: N’ụzọ ụfọdụ, ụlọ ọrụ ndị kara buo ibu nwere ụgbọ elu nke ha, mana maka ụzọ ndị ọzọ na obere ụlọ ọrụ ndị ọzọ enwere otu nsogbu.
translations.reference: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
translations.hypothesis: Some of the larger companies have their own planes, but for other means of transportation and smaller companies there is a more level playing field.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ha jị ụgbọelu ziga ihe, n'ụfọdụ ụzọ, ikekwe ọ gaara ewe ọtụtụ ụbọchị igafere mbupusi na ndị kọstom.
translations.reference: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
translations.hypothesis: If they ship it via air, it will probably take several days to go through customs and delivery.

translations.source: Naanị ụzọ a ga-esi ewefe ya ọsịịsọ wụbụ iziga ya dị ka ibu e nyochagoro. Iwu ụlọọrụ ụgbọelu agaghị ekwe ha izipụ ibu na-enweghị otu onye njem, nke bụ ebe ị ga-esi bata n'ime.
translations.reference: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
translations.hypothesis: The only way to get it on board is to ship it as a manifest cargo. Airlines are unlikely to let you on with a package unless it is a checked bag, which is where you put things you want to take with you.

translations.source: Ụzọ kachasị doo anya nke ife n’ime klaasị mbụ ma ọ bụ azụmahịa bụ iwepụta nnukwu ego maka urūàmàrà (ma ọ bụ, nke ka mma, mee ka ụlọ ọrụ gị mere gị ya).
translations.reference: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
translations.hypothesis: The most obvious way to get funding in the startup or business world is to raise capital (or, even better, build your own startup).

translations.source: Mana nke a adịghị ọnụ ala: dịka ihe i ga-ebu n'uche, lewe anya ịkwụ ugboro anọ ihe a na-akwụ maka ekọnọmi nkịtị maka biznes, na ihe ruru ugboro iri na otu maka fest klas!
translations.reference: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
translations.hypothesis: But this is not cheap: expect to pay four times more than normal business class rates, and up to eleven times more than economy class!

translations.source: Ikwu n'ozuzu, ọ baghị uru ọbụna ị na-ele anya maka ụmụ mbelata maka ochie ndị azụmaahịa ma ọ bụ klaasị-mbụ n'ụmụ njem ụgbọelu ozugbo sitere na A ruo B.
translations.reference: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
translations.hypothesis: In general, it is not worth it even if you are only looking for the lowest prices on legacy fares or on first class tickets on routes A to B.

translations.source: Ndị ụgbọ elu mara nke ọma na o nwere isi òtù ndị na-agba ụgbọ elu ndị nwere ike ịkwụ ezigbo ego maka urūàmàrà nke irute ebe ọzọ ọsịsọ nakwa n’ezigbo ọnọdụ, ma gbaa ụgwọ etu o kwesịrị.
translations.reference: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
translations.hypothesis: Airlines are well aware that they have a bunch of passengers who are willing to pay a premium for the convenience of getting to their final destination quickly and safely, and they cater to that segment of the market.

translations.source: Isiobodo nke Moldova bụ Chișinău. Asụsụ keobodo ahụ bụ Romanian, mana a na-ejikarị Rọshịan.
translations.reference: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
translations.hypothesis: The capital of Moldova is Chișinău. The official language is Romanian, but Russian is more commonly used.

translations.source: Moldova mba nwere ọtụtụ-agbụrụ nke nke tagwere ahụhụ sitere na ndọkụrịta agbụrụ.
translations.reference: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.hypothesis: Multicultural Moldova has a history of ethnic tensions.

translations.source: N'afọ 1994, ọgbaaghara a butere nkepụta Mba Transnistria kenkwupụta-onwe n'ime ebe ọwụwaanyanwụ Moldova, nke nwere ọchịchị na ego nke ya mana onweghi mba ọbụla so n'otu UN nabatara ya.
translations.reference: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.hypothesis: In 1994, separatists created the self-declared Republic of Transnistria in the eastern part of Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised as a country by any UN member states.

translations.source: E dozigharịala njikọ akụnaụba dị n'etiti nkewa Moldova abụọ a n’agbanyeghi ọdịda na mkpakọrịta nkwe nke ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị.
translations.reference: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.hypothesis: Economic links between the two Moldovan states have been restored despite the political and military divide.

translations.source: Okpukpe kachasị n'ime Moldova bụ Ụka Kraịstị Keọdịnala.
translations.reference: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.hypothesis: The predominant religion in Moldova is the Romanian Orthodox Church.

translations.source: Izmir bụ obodo nke atọ kacha buo ibu na mba Tọkị nwere ọnụọgụgụ ndị mmadụ dị ihe dịka nde 3. 7, ọdụ ụgbọmmiri nke abụọ kacha buo ibu ma a gụpụ Istanbulu, na ọdụ ụgbọ njem dị ezigbo mma.
translations.reference: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.hypothesis: İzmir is Turkey's third most populous city with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul and a major tourist destination.

translations.source: Obodo ochie nke Smyrna na mbụ, ọ bụzi ugbu a otu ebe na-ewi ewi, mepere emepe, na azụmaahịa dịnọrụ, e wubere gburugburu otu nnukwu ọnụ mmiri ma ụmụ ugwu gbaakwa ya gburugburu.
translations.reference: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.hypothesis: The ancient city of Smyrna, now a modern, open, and commercial city, is built around a natural harbor and protected by surrounding hills.

translations.source: Ụmụ buulivadị ahụ sara mbara, ụlọ ndị nwere karama n'ihu ha na ebe ụlọ ahịa na-ewi ewi bụ ndị e wubechara n'iji eluụlọ taịlị-uhie keọdịnala, ụlọ ahịa narị afọ iri na asatọ ahụ, na ụmụ ụlọ alakụba na ụlọ ụka, agbanyeghị n'obodo ahụ nwere nkwụrụ nke kara bụrụ Mediterranean Yurop karịa Tọki keọdịnala.
translations.reference: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.hypothesis: The buildings are generally low, with balconies and shops on the ground floor, and the whole town is a warren of narrow streets, alleys, and stairways, with a Mediterranean feel more akin to a Greek island than mainland Turkey.

translations.source: Obodo Haldarsvik na-ekwe ka ahụta Eysturọị, agwaetiti dị ya nso, ma nwekwaa ụlọ ụka akụkụ asatọ pụrụ iche.
translations.reference: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.hypothesis: The town of Haldorsvik is a good base from which to explore the nearby island of Eysturoy, and has a number of unique guesthouses.

translations.source: Na yaadị ụlọ ụka, e nwere ụmụ nduru akpụrụ n’ofe ụfọdụ ili na-adọrọ mmasị.
translations.reference: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
translations.hypothesis: In the backyard, there are a few ponds with some very interesting fish.

translations.source: Ọ meritere nkeji iri atọ iji gagharịa n’ime obodo ahụ na-akpali akpali.
translations.reference: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
translations.hypothesis: He spent thirty minutes wandering around the bustling city.

translations.source: Na aka-ugwu ma gburu-gburu dikwa nso igaru di obodo ihunanya na itunanya Sintra bukwa nke emere amara-amara nye ndi mba-ozo ka akowaputara idi-ukwu ya n’uzo egbuke-egbuke site na-aka Onye-nwe Byro.
translations.reference: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
translations.hypothesis: The historic centre of Sintra is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and its palaces and gardens are among the most popular tourist attractions in the country.

translations.source: Bọọsụ 403 Scotturb na-eme njem mgbedum aga Sintra, na-akwụsị na Cabo da Roca.
translations.reference: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
translations.hypothesis: Bus 403 goes to Sintra and back, stopping at Cabo da Roca.

translations.source: Ọzọkwa n'ugwu leta nnukwu Ebe Nsọ nke Nwanyị Anyị nke Fatima (Ebenchụaja), otu ebe ama ama n'ụwa niile maka ụmụ ihe ngosipụta nke Marịa.
translations.reference: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.hypothesis: Also in the holy city is the Great Mosque of Our Lady of Fatima (Al-Masjid al-Haram), the most famous and important of all the Mosques in the world.

translations.source: biko cheta na ebe ina aga izute bu n’ezie ogige eliri otutu ozu, dika kwa nwere ihe-oputara ana agaghi agutali onu nye okere onu-ogugu uwa putara-ihe
translations.reference: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.hypothesis: Please note that the meeting place is actually a cemetery, and as such is a quiet, respectful place for a few thousand people to gather.

translations.source: A ka nwere ọtụtụ ndị dị ndụ taa lanarịrị oge ha nọrọ ebe a, na ọtụtụ ndị ọzọ ndị nwere ndị ha hụrụ n'anya ndị e gburu ma ọ bụ jiri ọrụ gbuo ha ebe ahụ, ma Ndị Juu ma ndị ọzọ na-abụghị Ndị Juu.
translations.reference: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
translations.hypothesis: There are still many survivors alive today, and many more who have lost loved ones in the Holocaust, both Jewish and non-Jewish.

translations.source: Biko kwanyere webụsaịt a ugwu niile dịịrị ya. Ejila Họlọkọst maọbụ ndị Nazi eme ihe ụka ọchị.
translations.reference: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
translations.hypothesis: Please respect this website and its users. Do not use Holocaust or Nazi related terms in a flippant or humorous way.

translations.source: Emebila saịtị ahụ site n'ise akara maọbụ ịkanye grafiti n'ime ihe ndi owuwu.
translations.reference: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
translations.hypothesis: Do not damage the site by carving initials or other graffiti into the rocks.

translations.source: Ụmụ isi asụsụ nke Baselona bụ Katalan na Spanish. Ihe dị ka ọkara kara chọọ ịsụ Katalan, imirikiti na-aghọta ya, ma onye niile kendịnuche mara Spanish.
translations.reference: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
translations.hypothesis: The official languages of Barcelona are Catalan and Spanish. About half of the population can speak Catalan, the majority can understand it, and everyone knows some Spanish.

translations.source: Ma otu-osi-di, ihe-ngosi ka n’onu ogugu ka egosiri na asusu Catalan nani n’ihi na eguzosiri ya ike n’iwu dika asusu nke bu nke obodo.
translations.reference: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
translations.hypothesis: However, the show was subtitled in Catalan only because it was legally required as a regional language.

translations.source: Ma, a na-ejikwa asụsụ ndị Spenụ njem ọha ebe ọ dị ukwuu nakwa akụrụngwa ndị ọzọ.
translations.reference: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
translations.hypothesis: However, Spanish is also the second most commonly spoken language in the world and is used in many public services and institutions.

translations.source: A na-ama ọkwa mgbedum na Metro naanị na asụsụ Catalan, mana mmesasị nke a na-emeghị atụmatụ ya bụ ndị a na-ekwuputa site na sistemụ akpaghị aka n'ọtụtụ asụsụ dịgasị iche iche gụnyere Spanish, English, French, Arabic na Japanese.
translations.reference: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
translations.hypothesis: Metro announcements are only made in Catalan, but this speech is automatically translated into several other languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.

translations.source: Ndi Parisi nwere aha imaara isi, nganga na mpako.
translations.reference: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
translations.hypothesis: The Parisians had a reputation for being rude, arrogant and aggressive.

translations.source: Mgbe nke a na-abụkarị naanị nhụnuche na-ezighị ezi, ụzọ kachasị mma iji na-aga n’ihu n’ime Parii bụ na ị nọ n’omume gị kachasị mma, na-eme ka onye bụ "bien élevé" (a zụrụ nke ọma). Ọ ga-eme ka ngagharị n’ebe ahụ kara dị mfe.
translations.reference: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
translations.hypothesis: When this is just a formality, the best way to go about getting into a party is to be yourself and act like a "bien élevé" (well-bred) person. This will make your movements around the place more fluid.

translations.source: Agwa ọjọọ Ndị Pari ga-akwụsị ọsịịsọ ma ọ bụrụ na i gosi ụfọdụ nruweisi nkịtị.
translations.reference: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
translations.hypothesis: Evil spirits will be repelled if you show any normal human emotions.

translations.source: Ebe nnọkọọha mba nke Ụmụ ndọrọ mmiri Plitvice nwere oke ọhịa, nwejuru ụmụ osisi beech, spruce, na fir, ma nweekwa mwụkọta nke Alpine na ahịhịa Mediterranean.
translations.reference: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
translations.hypothesis: The Plitvice Lakes National Park is heavily forested, with areas of beech, spruce, and fir, and also has alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.

translations.source: Onwere otutu osisi ama ama, maka ebea nwere klimeti di icheiche, aja ya di iche iche, altitude ya dikwa iche n’iche.
translations.reference: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
translations.hypothesis: There are many different kinds of rainforests, depending on the climate, soils and elevation.

translations.source: Ebe a bụkwa ebe obibi nye ọtụtụ ụdị dị iche iche nke ụdị ụmụ anụmanụ na ụmụ nnụnnụ.
translations.reference: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
translations.hypothesis: It is also home to a wide variety of animal and plant species.

translations.source: Ụmụ anụmanụ nke ebe obibi pụrụ iche nke anaghị ahụkarị dị ka anụ ọhịa bea ndị Yurop na-acha uri, agụ owulu, ugo, ikwiikwii, nwamba oke ọhịa linz, e nwere ike ịhụ nwamba oke ọhịa na eruru, ya na ọtụtụ ụdị ndị ọzọ a na-ahụkarị.
translations.reference: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
translations.hypothesis: Typical fauna of the region include animals such as the European bison, wolves, bears, lynx, wild boar, wolverine, elk, and many species of birds.

translations.source: Ụmụ nwanyị na-aga na monastrị ga-eyi sket na-ekpuchi ikpere ha ma mechiekwa ubu ha.
translations.reference: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.hypothesis: Women going to the monastery wear a sari or a long skirt and cover their heads.

translations.source: Ọtụtụ n'ime ebe obibi ndị mọnk na-enye akwa mkpuchi maka ụmụ nwanyị ndị bịara na-adịghị njikere, mana ọ bụrụ na ị weta nke gị, tụmadị nke nwere agba chapụrụ achapụ, ị ga enweta otu mmụmụ ọnụ ọchị sitere na mọnk ma ọ bụ nọn nọ n'ọnụ ụzọ ahụ.
translations.reference: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the monasteries provide blankets for female visitors who come without bedding, but if you bring your own, especially a colourful one, you are more likely to get a friendly smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.

translations.source: N'otu ụzọ ahụ, a chọrọ ka ụmụ nwoke na-eyi ụmụ traụza na-ekpuchi ikpere.
translations.reference: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
translations.hypothesis: Similarly, men are expected to wear trousers that cover the knees.

translations.source: E nwere ike ịgbaziri nke a kwa site n'akwa ndị nọ n'ọnụ ụzọ mana anaghị asa akwa ahụ ma mmadụ yichaa ya mere ị nwere ike ị gaghị enwe ahụ iru ala iyi sket ndị a. Otu nha na-adaba ụmụ nwoke niile!
translations.reference: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.hypothesis: This can be avoided by using a helmet with a chinstrap, but the helmet must be properly fitted and adjusted so that it does not come off during a crash. One size fits most adults!

translations.source: Nri ndị Majorca, dị ka nke ndị mpaghara ndị yiri ya n'ime Mediterranean, na-adabere n'achịcha, akwụkwọ nri na anụ (tụmadị anụ ezi), ma na-eji mmanụ oliv mgbe niile.
translations.reference: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.hypothesis: The cuisine of Majorca, like that of other Mediterranean areas, is based on olive oil, vegetables, fruit and fish (especially grilled fish), and is often seasoned with herbs.

translations.source: Pa amb Oli bụ nri abalị dị mfe nke amaara ọkachasị n'oge sọma: Achịcha na mmanụ oliv, tomato, na ụmụ orishirishi ndị ọzọ dị adị dịka chiizi, azụ tuna, dzg.
translations.reference: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
translations.hypothesis: Pan amb oli is a simple dish based on the Mediterranean diet: a base of olive oil, tomato, and other available vegetables, such as onion, garlic, tuna, etc.

translations.source: Aha niile, tinyere okwu Sie maka gị, na-ebidokarị n’iji mkpụrụ edemede ukwu, ọbụnadị n’etiti ahịrịokwu.
translations.reference: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
translations.hypothesis: All words, except for the word "you", are usually capitalized, even in the middle of sentences.

translations.source: Ụzọ a bụ ụzọ dị mkpa e si amata ihe dị iche n’etiti ụfọdụ ngwaa na nnara.
translations.reference: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.hypothesis: This approach is a useful way to identify some of the differences between the various forms.

translations.source: Ọ na-emekwa ka ọgụgụ dị mfe karịa, mana edemede bịara ratụ ahụ maka aghaghị ịmara ma ngwaa maọbụ nkọwa aha ọbụla ọ bụ mpụta ahịrịokwu ahụ.
translations.reference: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.hypothesis: It does make the numbers a little easier to read, but the reader must still be aware of whether a number or a word is the subject of the sentence.

translations.source: Mkpọpụta okwu dịtụ mfe n' Ịtalịan ebe ọtụtụ mkpụrụokwu bụ ndị a na-akpọpụta kpọmkwen etu esi dee ha
translations.reference: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.hypothesis: The Italian language has a relatively simple orthography, with a high degree of correspondence between the written and spoken forms.

translations.source: Ụmụ isi mkpụrụabịdịị ndị a ga-elesi anya maka bụ c na g, ebe mkpọpụta ha na-adị iche na-ndabere na ụdaume na-esote.
translations.reference: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.hypothesis: The only letters that are affected by tone are c and g, whose pronunciations change depending on the tone that follows them.

translations.source: Jisiekwa ike hụ na ị kpọpụtara r na rr n'ụzọ dị iche. caro pụtara ezigbo, ebe carro pụtara ụgbọ ịnyịnya.
translations.reference: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.hypothesis: Also, be careful to distinguish between r and rr. Carro means "dear", while garro means "car".

translations.source: Asụsụ Peshịa nwere ụtọasụsụ kacha dị mfe ma bụrụ nke a kacha agbaso.
translations.reference: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.hypothesis: The Persian language has a very simple and regular morphology.

translations.source: Ya bu igu akwukwo uto asusu ga enyere gi aka imuta maka uto asusu Persia makwa ghota ahiriokwu ofuma.
translations.reference: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
translations.hypothesis: It is a good book to help you get started with Persian and understand the basics of the language.

translations.source: Ọ baghị uru ikwu, ọ bụrụ na ị mara otu asụsụ Ịhụnanya, ọ ga-adịtụ mfe ịmụta asụsụ Pọtụgiiz.
translations.reference: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
translations.hypothesis: It is worth noting that if you know one Romance language, you will find it easy to learn Portuguese.

translations.source: Agbanyeghi, ndị mara asụsụ Spenụ obere nwere ike ikpebi ọsịịsọ na ya na asụsụ Pọtugiizi yrir nke ọma na o kwesịghị ka a mụọ ya n’iche.
translations.reference: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
translations.hypothesis: However, Spanish speakers can often guess at the meaning of Portuguese words and phrases with some success and should not have too much trouble learning to read it.

translations.source: Ọbzavetrị ndị oge gara aga anaghị abachazi uru taa; e jizi ha eme ụlọ ndokwa ihe nka maọbụ ebe mmụta.
translations.reference: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
translations.hypothesis: The old observatories are not without value today; some of them have been converted into museums or planetariums.

translations.source: Dị ka mmetọ keọkụ n'isimbụ ha abụghị ụdị nsogbu ọ bụ ugbu a, a na-ahụkarị ha n'ime obodo ma ọ bụ na kampọs, nke dị mfe irute karịa ndị ahụ arụrụ n'oge ugbu a.
translations.reference: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
translations.hypothesis: While each of the towers is a feat of engineering, they are relatively simple structures, built in towns or on campuses, and easily accessible.

translations.source: Otutu teliskop eji eme resaach n'oge ugbu a bu nnukwu ulo oru di n'ebe dipuru adipu nwere ezigbo ihu igwe.
translations.reference: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
translations.hypothesis: Many modern research telescopes are large optical telescopes with computer-controlled mirrors and lenses.

translations.source: Nlere ifuru Cheri, nke a maara dị ka hanami, bụ omenala na Japan kemgbe nari afọ nke 8.
translations.reference: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
translations.hypothesis: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, is a traditional Japanese custom dating back to the Nara period (710–794).

translations.source: Echiche ahụ sitere na mba Chaịna bịa ebe plum blossom bụ okooko kacha amasị.
translations.reference: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
translations.hypothesis: The concept comes from China where the plum blossom is the national flower.

translations.source: Na Japan, Onye eze Emperọ haziri mmemme mkpụrụ osisi cheri izizi maka naanị ya na ndị otu ndị ọzọ na-ahụ maka ọchịchị Ụlọ ikpe etiti.
translations.reference: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
translations.hypothesis: In Japan, the Emperor performed the first part of the traditional Shichi-Go-San festival with other members of the Imperial Family.

translations.source: Ụmụ akụmakụ na-adị n'ụdị ha kacha mma mgbe ha nọ na gburugburu ebe obibi ekere, ya mere gbochie ọnwụnwa iwepụ ọbụna "naanị otu" ihe nlere.
translations.reference: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
translations.hypothesis: The details are best seen in the animal's natural habitat, so avoid any "quick-fix" solutions such as taking a single photo.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eleta otu ubi ahazigoro etu o kwesịrị, ị na-ewere "ụmụ ihe nlere" ga-eme ka a chụpụ gị, na-emeghị mkparịta ụka.
translations.reference: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
translations.hypothesis: If you visit a properly managed zoo, the "viewing experience" is carefully designed to prevent you from getting hurt, while still allowing you to observe the animals up close.

translations.source: Singapore bu kwanu ebe di mma ino makwa igaghari ma inwere ike igote ihe o bula i choro ma irute.
translations.reference: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
translations.hypothesis: Singapore is a great place to visit and you can get almost anything you need or want there.

translations.source: Mana ị na-edobe gị n'ime "ebe ndị na-ekpo oke ọkụ" ị ga-achọ naanị digiri ole na ole n'ugwu nke ikwuetọ imeso ma ekpomọkụ (mgbe niile) ma anwụ siri ike (mgbe elu igwe kpochara ekpocha, nke kara raa ahụ omume).
translations.reference: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
translations.hypothesis: But if you're staying in the "hot zone" you'll only need a few warm layers for the chilly evenings (when the sun goes down it can get quite cold, and the higher the altitude the colder it gets).

translations.source: E nwekwara ụfọdụ burumbu na-aga mgbago ugwu ruo Hebrọn, ebe ọdịnala e liri ndị nnaochie nke akwụkwọ nso bụ Ebraham, Aịzik, Jekọb, na ndị nwunye ha.
translations.reference: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
translations.hypothesis: There are also some tombs along the way to Hebron, where the traditional burial place of the patriarchs and matriarchs — Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives — is located.

translations.source: Lelee na bọọsụ ị na-eche maka ịbanye na ya na-aga Hebron ma ọ bụghị naanị na ebe obibi ndị Juu nke Kiryat Arba dị nso.
translations.reference: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
translations.hypothesis: Check to see if the bus you are taking goes to Hebron or just to the Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.

translations.source: Ụzọ mmiri ndị ime obodo nwere ike ịbụ ezigbo isiokwu iji hazie oge ezumike.
translations.reference: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
translations.hypothesis: The local waterways can be a major attraction for recreational use.

translations.source: Maka ọmụmatụ ileta ụmụ nnukwu ụlọ n’ime Ndagwurugwu Loire, Ndagwurugwu Rhine ma ọ bụ ime njem ụgbọ mmiri gaa obodo ndị na-adọrọ mmasị n’ime Danube ahụ ma ọ bụ ịgba ụgbọ mmiri n’ogologo ụzọ Kanaal Erie ahụ.
translations.reference: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
translations.hypothesis: For example, consider visiting the castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine Valley or take a boat trip to the interesting towns along the Danube or cruise along the Erie Canal.

translations.source: Ha na akọwapụtakwa ụmụ ụzọ a ga-eso maka ụzọ haịkịnụ na ọghụgha igwe ama ama.
translations.reference: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
translations.hypothesis: They also discuss the logistics of a manned mission to the most famous of the planets.

translations.source: Ekeresimesi bụ otu n’ime ezumike kachasị mkpa nke Ndị na-eso Ụzọ Kraịst, ma a na-eme ememme ya dị ka ncheta omumu Jizos.
translations.reference: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
translations.hypothesis: Christmas is one of the most important holidays for Christians, and it is celebrated as a commemoration of Jesus' birth.

translations.source: Ndi na-ekweghi na Chukwu na mba ndi otu Kristi gasi ma ndi n’abughi ndi otu Kristi n’uwa niile anabatago otutu odinala enwere maka oge ezumike.
translations.reference: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
translations.hypothesis: Both religious and secular holidays are celebrated by Christians and non-Christians around the world.

translations.source: Enwere ọdịnala maka ịmụ anya n'abalị Ista n'ebe mepere emepe iji hụ ọwụwa anyanwụ.
translations.reference: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
translations.hypothesis: There is a tradition to watch the sunrise on the first day of the Istiqlal in the open air.

translations.source: Enwere n'ezie nkọwa na nkà mmụta okpukpe nke Ndị Kraịst maka ọdịnala a, mana ọ nwere ike bụrụ emume ọmụmụ tupu nchụaja Oge mmiri na Ọmụmụ nwa Ndị Kristi abịa.
translations.reference: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
translations.hypothesis: There is some information on Christian traditions about this festival, but it may be a pre-Christian festival.

translations.source: Ọtụtụ ụlọụka agba ochie na-amụkarị anya abalị Ista n'abalị Satọde n'oge ngwụcha izu Ista, ebe ndị ụka na-abanye na mmemme ma ọ kụọ elekere abụọ nke etiti abalị iji mee mmemme mbilite n'ọnwụ Kraịstị.
translations.reference: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
translations.hypothesis: Many historic churches hold special services on Saturday night or Sunday morning during Holy Week, with the services often including a re-enactment of the Last Supper.

translations.source: Ụmụ anụmanụ niile ndị nke bịarutere n’ime agwaetiti ndị ahụ bịarutere ebe a site n’igwu mmiri, ife efe ma ọ bụ ise n’elu mmiri.
translations.reference: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
translations.hypothesis: All animals that have ever lived on an island have arrived there by sea, air or land.

translations.source: N'ihi ogologo ntoanya site na kọntinentị ahụ ụmụ anụ na-an̄ụ ara enwenwughị ike ịga njem ahụ ya mere na-eme nnukwu mbe isi anụmanụ na-ata ahịhịa n'ime Galapagos ahụ.
translations.reference: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the great distance from the mainland, the animals there have not developed many defenses against being eaten, so the Galapagos have a high number of herbivores.

translations.source: Ke,gbe mbịarute nke mmadụ na Galapagos, ewebatala ọtụtụ anụ na-an̄ụ ara gụnyere ewu, inyinya, ehi, oke, nwamba na nkịta.
translations.reference: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
translations.hypothesis: Since the arrival of humans to the Galapagos, many animals have been introduced including pigs, donkeys, goats, cattle, cats and dogs.

translations.source: Ọ bụrụ na ị leta ụmụ ebe Aktik ma ọ bụ Antatik n'ime oge oyi ị ga-enwe ahụmihe nke abalị pola, nke pụtara na anyanwụ agaghị awa na horaịzọn ahụ.
translations.reference: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
translations.hypothesis: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic during the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun will not rise above the horizon.

translations.source: Nke a na-enye ezigbo ohere iji hụ Aurora borealis, dị ka eluigwe ga-agba itiri karịa ma ọ bụ obere gburugburu elekerea ahụ.
translations.reference: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
translations.hypothesis: This gives a better chance of seeing the aurora, as the sky is darker and less light pollution.

translations.source: Dika ebe ndị ahụ bụ ebe ndị mmadụ ebichabeghị etu ahụ, na mmetọ nke ọkụ ya mere anaghị abụkarị nsogbu, ị ga-enwekwa ike ịnụ ụtọ ụmụ kpakpando.
translations.reference: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
translations.hypothesis: As these are areas where people have not built up to block out the sky, and the air is clear, you will be able to see the stars.

translations.source: Omenala ọrụ ndị Japan nwere ogugo na iwu dị iche iche karịa ihe ndị ọdịda anyanwụ maara.
translations.reference: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
translations.hypothesis: Japanese work culture has a reputation for being more formal than what Westerners are used to.

translations.source: Suutu uwe azụmaahịa izugbe, ma ndị ọrụ ibe na-akpọ onye ọ bụla site n'aha ezinụlọ ha ma ọ bụ site n'aha ọrụ ha.
translations.reference: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
translations.hypothesis: Wear a business casual attire, and address colleagues by their surnames or professional titles.

translations.source: Nkwekorita nke ebe oru di nkpa, na-ekwusi ike na mbọ otu karịa ito ụmụ mmezu nke otu onye.
translations.reference: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
translations.hypothesis: Collaboration between key stakeholders is critical to achieving results beyond what any one organization could accomplish alone.

translations.source: Ndi oru kwesiri inweta nkwado onye isi ha maka mkpebi obula ha ga ekpebi, ha kwesikwara irube isi n’ozi o bula onye isi ha ziri ha n’ajughi ajuju.
translations.reference: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
translations.hypothesis: Subordinates should receive clear direction from their superiors for every decision they make and should always follow their superiors' instructions without question.
